## REQ-331 — The demo's issues get fixed: the assistant never re-asks a customer or start day it was already told, and never duplicates a customer (demo-loop cycle 1, m7 + m44)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none". Demo-loop cycle 1 (run r20a1d9c2), issues `m7` — "The assistant asks again for details already given (customer, start day)" — and `m44` — "A duplicate customer is easy to create from the chat's '+ New customer', and the AI asks 'Business or person?' for an existing customer".
**Cause (RCA m7/m44, commit 4da03589):** (a) the customer step's question `termsWizard.customer.question` ("Is this for a business or a person?") and the lock CTA `chatCoordinator.lockedToTermsCta` / `lockQuote.cta.lockedPrompt` were emitted for every quote, even with a customer bound; (b) the chat `create_quote` path (handle-chat-message) inherited only `conv.customerId`, so a typed "for María López" bound nobody and the step opened its pick list; (c) `extractCustomerName` needed a Capitalized run right after "for/para" — "for customer x", "para la señora López", "this is X" → null — and `extractServiceAddress` had no ES "calle Elm 512" or number-less "on Oak St 78704"; (d) `extractStartDate` knew no weekday words, so "empezar el lunes" was asked again; (e) `create_new` in handle-wizard-answer validated the contact and called `customers.create()` with no lookup, so "x" could be created twice.
**Requirement:** (1) `extractCustomerName` reads lowercase connectors and honorifics ("for customer X", "para el cliente X", "para la señora X", "for Mrs. X", "this is X", "es para X", "for the Hendersons"; a single lowercase word right after "customer"/"cliente" is the name). (2) `extractServiceAddress` reads "calle Elm 512[, Austin TX 78704]" and a number-less "on <Street> <St> [City] <ZIP>" (ZIP required — "on Monday" is never an address). (3) `extractStartDate` reads weekday words EN/ES, accent-blind, with "next/this/próximo/este" — the next occurrence strictly after today — plus "tomorrow/mañana", feeding `wizardPrefillFor("start_date")`. (4) A new `shared/quote-flow/customer-dedupe.ts`: `findExistingCustomer` (same-owner match by phone's trailing 10 digits, email case-blind, then the whole name accent-/case-blind — a partial name never matches) and `knownCustomerForStep` (the bound customer, else the facts' match). (5) `create_new` binds the existing match instead of creating a second row unless `customer.create.allowDuplicate` is set; the island's create form live-searches what is typed and offers "Use <name>" / "Create anyway" before Next. (6) The chat `create_quote` path resolves the typed facts to the contractor's own customer and binds `conv.customerId` (+ the quote's); a name nobody has binds nothing. (7) With a customer bound, the lock CTA names them (`chatCoordinator.lockedToTermsCtaKnown` / `lockQuote.cta.lockedPromptKnown`, payload `customerName`) and the island shows one Continue instead of Business/Person; the first wizard step asks `termsWizard.customer.questionKnown`; the customer step opens on a one-tap "Use <name> ✓" card with "Change" to the list. en + es in sync.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/wizard-known-facts.test.ts` ("REQ-331 …": every extractor case above, `findExistingCustomer`, `knownCustomerForStep`) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-wizard-answer/int.test.ts` ("REQ-331 m44 …": a name / phone / email match binds the existing customer with no second row; `allowDuplicate` creates; another owner's customer never matches), `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts` ("REQ-331 m7 …": "Quote for customer Maria Lopez" binds conv + quote to María López; an unknown name binds nothing; the lock CTA names the bound customer), `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/transition-to-terms/int.test.ts` ("REQ-331: … 'use them or change' question") · e2e n/a — the browser lane is not run in this cycle; the decisions live in shared pure logic and the coordinators, which the unit + integration tests drive on a real KV.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c1-wizard-known-facts off origin/demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first — jest: 13 extractor cases "Expected: 'Maria Lopez' / 'Calle Elm 512' / {iso: '2026-11-16'…} Received: null"; deno: "REQ-331 m44: create_new whose name matches … FAILED (AssertionError: Values are not equal: no duplicate row)", "REQ-331 m7: create_quote 'for <Name>' … FAILED", "lock CTA names them … FAILED", "transition-to-terms … FAILED" → "FAILED | 2 passed | 5 failed". GREEN — `npx jest --selectProjects unit` (new file + quote-facts, prefill, customer-step, lang neighbours) → "Test Suites: 156 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 1481 passed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/ src/crm/domain/data/customer-store/` → "ok | 368 passed | 0 failed"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on islands/AsstChat.tsx, clients/assistant.ts and every touched backend/shared file; `deno fmt --check` clean on every touched file except the known-unformattable AsstChat.tsx (not formatted).
## REQ-295 — The customer's demo pill holds one clear spot: never over the page's content, no hopping, and the presenter sees its box (demo-loop cycle 1, issue M1)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1 (`demo-loop/runs/r20a1d9c2/demo-report.md`), issue **M1** "Customer's demo pill moves around and covers content; presenter can't see it" (all 10 pairs; pair 3: "NO, I can't open ☰ — the pill's 'Connected' button is on top of it"). RCA (analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD, at `4da03589`): REQ-228 defined "clear" as "no CONTROL under it" (`shared/demo-mode/pill.ts` `CONTROL_SELECTOR`), so headings, totals, the signature canvas, footer text and a dialog's content were fair game; when every slot had a control, `pickPillSlot` fell back to the slot with the FEWEST controls — on a 390 px phone the top-left slot with just the ☰ button. The hops: a full page load reset `posRef` to null so the pill re-picked the first clear slot (a different one than before the reload), and the pill's own size change (Connected → Live, compact ↔ full) changed the slot geometry, which is computed from the pill's measured size; the position was set with no transition. The stage never shows the pill (`mirror-record.ts` skips `data-demo-overlay`, REQ-242 by design).
**Requirement (amends REQ-228):**
- A spot is clear only when nothing of the page is under it: no control (REQ-228's list), no image, canvas, svg or video, no dialog or its backdrop, no element with its own visible text, and no painted box (a background or border) that is smaller than most of the viewport. The page's root and body alone under it is clear.
- The pill never falls back onto the page. When no full-size spot is clear it shrinks to the compact form (the first presenter's colour dot, the status, End — REQ-228's phone pill) and tries again; when no compact spot is clear either, it reserves room instead of overlapping: the body is padded at the bottom by the pill's band (`--demo-pill-h`, the REQ-181 `--banner-h` way) and the pill sits bottom-left in that band. It returns to the full form once a full-size spot has been clear on two consecutive checks.
- The slots are computed from a reserved box — the pill's size rounded up to 40 px wide and 8 px tall steps — so a status change or a name cut does not move the slots; the pill sits inside its box, against the box's near edge.
- The chosen box is remembered per page path for the tab (`sessionStorage` `pm-demo-pill:<path>`): after a full page load the pill prefers that box while it is clear, so a reload does not hop it. A move glides (a 250 ms transition), it never jumps.
- The customer's page tells the stage where its pill is (peer message `{ k: "pill", r }`, `null` when it is gone), and the stage draws a faint dashed outline of that box over the mirror (`data-cy="demo-pill-ghost"`, titled "{name}'s demo pill") so the presenter knows what it hides.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-mode-pill.test.ts` ("REQ-295 …": what counts as the page under a box; `pickPillSlot` yields nothing when nothing is clear (the REQ-228 "fewest" case replaced); the reserved box's steps; `planPill` — full not clear → compact, compact not clear → bottom-left with room; the per-path slot memory; the pill room on body + html; the ghost box on the stage's fit; the overlay's wiring: the transition, the memory, `countsAsPage`, the `pill` message; the stage's ghost; en + es key), `jest/unit/demo-mode-protocol.test.ts` ("REQ-295": `pill` parses with a rect or null, junk dropped) · integration n/a — the relay forwards any parsed peer message unchanged (REQ-242's relay tests cover it); the behaviour is the browser's layout · e2e `e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-clear.e2e.test.ts` (REQ-228's story, amended: on the customer's desktop and phone the pill covers no control AND no text of the page; after a full reload of the same page the pill is back in the same box; the stage shows the pill's ghost inside the frame).
**Also amended (REQ-228's story had gone stale under later merges):** `demo-pill-clear.e2e.test.ts` waited for the stage status `/direct|relay/` — REQ-232 renamed it "Live" (2026-11-11 21:59) — and clicked End without REQ-235's `demo-end-confirm`; both fixed in this story (the same stale filter remains in `demo-ended` and `demo-restart`, other issues' stories). The REQ-153 AMENDMENT test's "nothing remembered" scan still forbids `sessionStorage` in the overlay; the pill's place memory lives in `shared/demo-mode/pill.ts` (`pillStore`), which remembers the pill's PLACE only.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, local, branch fix/c1-pill-placement off origin/demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'demo-mode-(pill|protocol)'` → "Tests: 13 failed, 26 passed" (no `countsAsPage`/`planPill`/`reservedBox`/`rememberPillBox`/`setPillRoom`/`pillGhostBox`, `pickPillSlot` still returning the fewest-controls slot, no `pill` peer message, no ghost on the stage); the story (own `SHOTS_DIR`, the session's default evidence dir is wiped by the parallel agents' runs) → `timed out: desktop: the pill covers no text (REQ-295) — "Meta Pixel (fake) · init 00000" @185,20` (a `pointer-events:none` ribbon hit-testing never reports — fixed with a once-per-check ghost scan), then `after a reload the pill is back in the same spot — before {"left":687,"top":12}, after {"left":748,"top":12}` (the pill right-anchored in its box moved with its own width — fixed: the pill sits at the box's top-left with `min-width` the box's width, and the full-size box never shrinks on a page), then a mid-glide read (fixed: the first placement snaps, the story reads a settled position). GREEN — `shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-clear.e2e.test.ts e2e/demo-mode/demo-mode.e2e.test.ts` → "✓ REQ-228 … 4.2s", "✓ REQ-153 + … 13.2s" (`demo-mirror.e2e.test.ts` fails on this host identically at HEAD 4da03589 in a pristine worktree — `demo-connecting` never shows within 15 s — so it is not this change); `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 155 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 1471 passed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/demo-mode/ src/core/entrypoints/compose-router/` → "ok | 30 passed | 0 failed"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on both islands and the two shared modules; `deno fmt --check` clean on all 9 touched files; en/es keys in sync.
## REQ-347 — The quote preview's terms are English in an English preview, even right after a Spanish wizard (demo-loop cycle 1, issue M16)
**Source:** Raphael, after the 20-agent demo: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1 (run r20a1d9c2), issue `M16` — "English preview of a Spanish quote keeps Spanish terms; preview and sent document disagree" (pair 6: START / TIME TO COMPLETE labels in English, values "La próxima semana" / "Estimado: 1 día" / "1 año"; the sent /q?lang=en read "Next week / 1 day / 1 year"). RCA verdict LIKELY, skeptic UPHELD.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked at 4da03589):** the preview's term rows (`front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx`, `termsByStep`) read `quote.terms` (stored in English, localized per preview language) only when present, else split the wizard transcript text at its colon — and the transcript is written in the contractor's UI language, while `localizeTermValue(…, "en")` is the identity. `postWizardAnswer` never re-read the quote, so the send card right after the last chip rendered from a quote fetched before the backend persisted the terms → transcript fallback → Spanish values in the English preview.
**Requirement:** the preview's terms always start from the same English base the agreement uses. (a) After every wizard answer the island re-reads the quote and takes its `terms` (and completion date), so the send card renders from the persisted terms. (b) When the quote has no terms yet, a transcript pick's value is resolved from its `optionId` → the wizard spec's option label in English (the rule the backend's `captureTerms` uses); only a custom pick's `customValue` is free text. The wizard spec's steps/options live in one shared module (`shared/quote-flow/wizard-terms.ts`) that the backend spec and the front-end preview both read.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/wizard-terms-preview.test.ts` ("REQ-347 …": a Spanish-UI transcript with no quote.terms → English preview rows "Next week / Estimated: 1 day / 1 year"; custom values stay free text; quote.terms wins; the island builds its rows with the helper and re-reads the quote after a wizard answer) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-wizard-answer/int.test.ts` ("REQ-347 …": a Spanish contractor walks the wizard; the preview helper over the coordinator's own Spanish transcript yields exactly the English terms persisted on the quote) · e2e `e2e/wizard-terms-lang/wizard-terms-lang.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-347: …" in a browser: a Spanish contractor finishes the wizard, flips the send card's preview to English with no reload — the term rows read Next week / Estimated: 1 day / 1 year, no Spanish).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c1-terms-fallback-refetch off demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first — `shots run e2e/wizard-terms-lang` → "✗ … expectation failed: start reads Next week (START La próxima semana TIME TO COMPLETE Estimated: 1 día PAYMENT Pago inmediato WARRANTY 1 año)" — the demo's exact symptom; jest unit and the int test → "Cannot find module …/shared/quote-flow/wizard-terms" (the helper did not exist). GREEN — `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 156 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 1462 passed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/render-quote-pdf` → "ok | 359 passed | 0 failed" (incl. the REQ-347 int test); `shots run e2e/wizard-terms-lang e2e/wizard-tbd` → "3 pass · 0 fail"; `deno check` + `deno lint` clean on `islands/AsstChat.tsx`, the backend spec and coordinator; `deno fmt --check` clean on the new files (the touched backend files were already fmt-unclean at base and are left as they were).
## REQ-310 — The demo's issues get fixed: the customer's link is one click away after a send, and "Copy link" says what it did (demo cycle 1, m13 + m32)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, demo-loop cycle 1 (demo-loop/runs/r20a1d9c2/demo-report.md, RCA m13 + m32): "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none". Demo issue m13 — "Hard to reach customer's link after sending: none in chat; /quotes card link blocked by front button"; m32 — "'Copy link' gives no confirmation".
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on demo-fixes `4da03589`):** `front-end/islands/QuoteCard.tsx:171-175` — the front `.qcard__cta` button only did `e.stopPropagation()` (no action), while `onCardClick` (128-136) returned early for it, so the card's most prominent button was a dead zone and the only `/q/:id` link lived on the back face (271-277), which is `pointer-events:none` until flipped (`static/quotes.css:238-245`). `front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx:7386-7420` — the chat's only copy-link control was a `role="menuitem"` inside the send button's channel menu; after a successful send the review card collapses to the `phase_divider` (5610+) and nothing renders the customer's link; the copy item's only confirmation was its own label for 1200 ms inside the menu it then closed, and a clipboard rejection (headless/unpermitted) closed the menu silently.
**Requirement:** (a) On /quotes the card's front CTA opens the quote panel (`onOpen(q.id)`, the same action as the back's Open; flips the card when no `onOpen` is wired) — the customer's link is reachable without flipping. ## REQ-301 — A stale /admin tab locks itself during a demo and the users table stays live (demo cycle 1, issues M18 + m35)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo's findings: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1, issues `M18` ("Stale admin tab shows raw 403 API errors") and `m35` ("/admin users table stale ('New user', business —) after onboarding"); RCA analyst + skeptic CONFIRMED/UPHELD at `4da03589`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on demo-fixes 4da03589):** Clicking Demo in tab A impersonates the customer for the whole browser (`DemoModeOverlay.tsx` placePresenter → `adminClient.impersonate`), so a /admin tab B opened earlier keeps its super-admin UI while every call now carries the customer's session: `require-super-admin` answers 403 and `front-end/lib/api.ts` throws `GET /admin/users failed: 403`, which `AdminPage.tsx` printed verbatim (`setError(err.message)` at search/demo/impersonate). Nothing in AdminPage re-checked whoami or heard the overlay. Separately, `useEffect(() => { search(); }, [])` loaded the users list exactly once — no refresh on focus, on an interval or after Demo — so a row read with the sign-up placeholder ("New user", business —) stayed that way, and `{u.name || "—"}` showed the placeholder as if it were a name while the backend read is live.
**Requirement:** (1) /admin never shows a raw API error. A 401/403 on any admin call — or any failure while whoami says the session is an impersonation — turns the page into a plain notice: "This window is in a demo as {customer} — go back to the demo or return to your account." with Back-to-the-demo and Reload buttons (a refused call that is NOT an impersonation says the session changed, Reload only); Search, Demo, Impersonate, Grant/Revoke and the feature switches are disabled while locked. (2) The overlay announces the impersonation the moment Demo places a presenter (`announceImpersonation`: a window event AND a BroadcastChannel so every other /admin tab of the same browser locks itself at once). (3) The users table stays live: `search()` re-runs when the tab becomes visible or gets focus, every `ADMIN_REFRESH_MS` (5 s) while visible and idle, and right after a Demo is opened; refreshes are quiet (no "Searching…" flicker, no error clobber). (4) A placeholder name (`isPlaceholderName`: empty, "New user", "Nuevo usuario") renders as "(no name yet)" / "(sin nombre aún)" — never as data — in the Users table, the Accounts column and the Impersonate select. Other API failures show the dictionary's plain message, never `${method} ${path} failed: ${status}`.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/admin-stale-tab.test.ts` ("REQ-301 …": `lockFor` maps 401/403 + impersonating whoami to the demo lock naming the customer, a refused non-impersonation to the session lock, a 500 to no lock; `displayName` hides placeholders; `refreshWhileVisible` runs on focus / visibilitychange / the interval only while visible and stops; `announceImpersonation`/`onImpersonation` reach the window event and the channel; source pins: AdminPage never renders `err.message`, listens with `onImpersonation`, polls with `refreshWhileVisible`, names with `displayName`; the overlay announces after impersonate; en + es carry the five keys) · integration n/a — no backend change: the 403 (`require-super-admin`) and the live `searchByPhone` read were already right; the defect is the island's state · e2e `e2e/admin-stale-tab/admin-stale-tab.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-301 M18: …" tab A on /admin, tab B of the same browser clicks Demo → tab A shows the notice naming the customer, Search/Demo disabled, no "failed: 403" anywhere, Back to the demo lands on /demo/stage; "REQ-301 m35: …" /admin lists a fresh account as "(no name yet)" / "—", the account finishes onboarding through the API, the row reads the real name and business within the poll with no reload).

## REQ-321 — An open page re-reads the server: /i/:id flips to PAID when the owner confirms, /quotes moves a signed quote (demo-loop cycle 1, issue M14)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1 (run r20a1d9c2), issue `M14` "Open page doesn't refresh status (invoice stays EN CONFIRMACIÓN after confirm; /quotes stale after signing)" — RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at `4da03589`; pair 9 customer 05:36:04 "the already-open /i/ tab stayed EN CONFIRMACIÓN · Pagado $0.00 until I RELOADED"; pair 3 /quotes "STALE: still 01 Out for response" after signing.
**Cause (RCA):** neither page re-read the server after first paint. `/i/:id` is SSR'd once; its island `PublicInvoiceClaim` had one fetch (the claim POST) and no effect/poll — after a claim it patched the `[data-status-pill]` text in place (UX-35), so the owner's later confirm-payment never reached the customer's tab; a page opened already claimed mounted no island at all. `QuotesPage` listed once in a mount-time `Promise.all(list, winRate, insight)` and registered no interval, focus or visibility listener. REQ-221's scheduler (`front-end/lib/poll.ts`, used by DashTopbar) existed and was not used here.
**Requirement:** (a) the public invoice page polls `GET /api/invoices/:id/public` every 10 s through REQ-221's scheduler and reloads the moment the server's invoice leaves the state the page shows — badge state (paid / claimed / open, `paidAt` counts as paid) or a republished version; the state it compares against is read at every tick, so the island's own claim moves the baseline to "claimed" instead of reloading; the SSR'd claimed page (no claim island) mounts a render-nothing `PublicInvoiceRefresh` island that does the same; a failed read reloads nothing; one reload, then the poll stops. (b) /quotes re-runs its list (and win rate) every 30 s through the scheduler — hidden tabs wait, one catch-up when shown — AND on the window's `focus`; one in-flight re-read at a time; a failed re-read keeps the last list; the first paint stays the mount fetch's.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/public-page-refresh.test.ts` ("REQ-321 …": `invoiceMoved` for same state / claimed→paid incl. paidAt / sent↔claimed / version; `startInvoiceRefresh` polls the public URL at 10 s, reloads once on paid and stops, reads `shown` at every tick, never reloads on a failed read; `startListRefresh` ticks at 30 s, focus re-reads, hidden tab waits + one catch-up, no stacked in-flight read; the wiring — PublicInvoiceClaim's effect, the route's claimed branch mounting PublicInvoiceRefresh, QuotesPage's `startListRefresh(…, 30_000)` and no bare setInterval) · integration n/a — no backend or API change; the public GET and confirm-payment are the existing routes (public-controller e2e.test.ts covers `GET /invoices/:id/public`) · e2e `e2e/public-page-refresh/public-page-refresh.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-321 M14: …" in a browser, no reload by the test: the customer claims IN the open /i/:id tab, the owner confirms via API, the badge turns PAID and the thanks block goes; a tab opened on an already-claimed invoice turns PAID too; /quotes moves a quote the customer signed via API out of "Out for response" into "Decided this month" on the window's focus).

## REQ-302 — A quote never carries a price that is not a price: no negative line, no zero total — in chat, in the store, at lock and at send (demo B1 + M29, demo-loop cycle 1)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo (demo-loop cycle 1, run r20a1d9c2): "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo issues `B1` ("A -$500 quote can be locked and sent; line shows -$500 but TOTAL $0.00") and `M29` ("Assistant accepts nonsense price 'abc' as $0.00 without asking"), demo-report.md pair 10 / fleet-9 lines 22, 39, 54, 332, 343.
**Cause (RCA, analyst + skeptic CONFIRMED at 4da03589):** nothing on the quote write path checked the sign or the zero — `openai-tools/mod.ts` parseToolCall only rejected non-finite numbers, `handle-chat-message/mod.ts` summed whatever the model sent into `estimatedTotal` and persisted it, `paperwork/dto/quote.ts` had no `@Min`, `QuoteStore.update` stored the patch verbatim, `lock-quote/mod.ts` locked `fresh.estimatedTotal ?? 0`, send-quote never looked at the total, and the card's "Lock it in" was disabled only on a missing quoteId. The "TOTAL $0.00" half: the chat island's `quote` state is loaded once per quoteId and the review card's TOTAL read `quote.estimatedTotal` while its lines came from the locked card; a create_quote that updated the draft in place carried no `quoteUpdated` payload (only update_job_details set it), so after the "-500" reprice the lines said -$500 and the total said the pre-correction $0.
**Requirement:** one rule, `shared/quote-flow/quote-price-guard.ts`, shared by server and island: a line is never negative, and the total is always above zero (a $0 line stays legal as an included item — REQ-267 — as long as the quote has a total). The chat coordinator refuses a priceless create_quote — nothing persisted, no card, no binding — and replies asking for the price (`chatCoordinator.priceMissing`, EN + ES, naming the line); a real reprice of the bound draft flags the card with `quoteUpdated` so the island re-reads the quote. The DTOs carry `@Min(0)` on a line's price and `@Min(1)` on estimatedTotal; `QuoteStore` create/update throw `QuotePriceError` on a negative line or a total at or below zero (judging only the fields the patch carries, so a lock stamp never re-validates an old row). LockQuote refuses the first lock of a priceless draft and SendQuote refuses to send one, both with the same reply. The island disables "Lock it in" on a priceless draft and the review card's TOTAL is the sum of the lines it renders.
**Decision (deviation from the fix direction):** the create_quote schema keeps `minimum: 0` and the parser keeps non-positive lines instead of dropping them — dropping them in the parser would turn "price abc" into "no action → generic fallback" rather than the price ask, and a $0 included line is a legitimate line REQ-267 already pins. The gate is the coordinator, where the conversation is known and the ask can be written.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/quote-price-guard.test.ts` ("REQ-302 …": the guard on $0 / negative / included-$0 / explicit-total / stored shapes; the island's Lock button and review-card TOTAL wiring; the coordinator's `quoteUpdated`; the EN+ES key), `backend/src/paperwork/dto/quote-price.test.ts` ("REQ-302 DTO …": negative line and zero total rejected on create and update, included $0 line still valid) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/domain/data/quote-store/price-guard.test.ts` ("REQ-302 quote-store …": create and update refuse, the row is kept, a lock stamp still goes through), `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts` ("REQ-302 M29 … 'price abc' → a $0 draft is NOT persisted; the reply asks", "REQ-302 B1 … a -$500 reprice of the bound draft is refused", "REQ-302 B1 … a real reprice flags the turn with quoteUpdated"), `lock-quote/int.test.ts` ("REQ-302 B1 lock-quote … refuses to lock"), `send-quote/int.test.ts` ("REQ-302 B1 send-quote: refuses to send …") · e2e n/a — the chat refusal needs a scripted model and the e2e server runs the echo stub, and a $0 / negative draft for the Lock button can no longer be created through any API or store path, so there is no browser-reachable way to set the scene; the int tests drive the coordinators on a real KV and the unit test pins the island's wiring.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c1-quote-price-validation off demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first — jest: "Cannot find module '../../shared/quote-flow/quote-price-guard'", then with the module in place "Tests: 4 failed, 5 passed" (Lock button, review TOTAL, `quoteUpdated`, lang key); deno `--filter REQ-302` over the five backend files: "FAILED | 0 passed | 8 failed" ("Values are not equal: no draft card for a $0 quote", "Expected function to reject." ×5, the reprice total unflagged). GREEN — the same deno set with neighbours (dto, quote-store, openai-tools, handle-chat-message, lock-quote, send-quote): "ok | 110 passed | 0 failed"; `deno test --parallel src/paperwork src/agents src/analytics src/crm`: "ok | 824 passed | 0 failed"; `npx jest --selectProjects unit`: "Test Suites: 156 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 1465 passed"; `front-end: deno test -A lib/` "ok | 90 passed"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on the touched backend modules and `islands/AsstChat.tsx`; `deno fmt --check` clean on every new file and on every touched file that was clean at HEAD.
## REQ-332 — 'Professionalize' keeps the scope; the price basis follows the job (demo cycle 1, issue m30)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1, issue `m30` — "'Professionalize' changes the meaning (permit scope; 'Prices include materials' though client buys vanity)" (demo-report.md pair 7; RCA at `4da03589`, analyst CONFIRMED / skeptic UPHELD).
**Cause (RCA):** (1) `professionalize-bullet/mod.ts` sent the single bullet (`Rough bullet:\n${text}`) with no job context, so "4 recesed lights + City of Austin permit" came back as "Install 4 recessed lights with permit" — a job-wide permit re-scoped onto one item — and the only guard, `isFaithfulTo` (one shared content word), accepted it. (2) "Prices include labor and materials" was not model output: `suggest-prices/mod.ts` hard-coded `basis: "labor_and_materials"` on every result (REQ-017 / NW-12) and the island printed the fixed label; the contractor's "they're buying the vanity themselves" never reached it.
**Requirement:** (1) Professionalize sees the job: the request carries the contractor's original message and the option's other bullets as context, the prompt says "do not merge, narrow, or re-scope items" and that a bullet joining two separate items with "+"/"plus" becomes two separate lines; the result is `{ text, lines }`. A "+"-joined bullet with N items must come back as N lines, each about its item, or the deterministic split is used instead; every line must still share a content word with the bullet. The picker applies several lines as several bullets in place; the `{ details }` shape flattens them. (2) The basis is derived from the raw message + confirmed scope (`deriveBasis`, EN + ES: the customer/client/owner buys, supplies, provides, already has; "labor only", "materials not included"; "el cliente compra / pone", "solo mano de obra"; the contractor's own buying does not count) → `"labor_and_materials"` or `"labor_materials_as_noted"`; the model is told when the customer supplies items; the island shows "Prices include labor; materials as noted in the job details" / "Los precios incluyen mano de obra; los materiales según se indica en los detalles del trabajo" for the latter; the draft persists `priceBasis` across a reload.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/price-basis/test.ts` ("REQ-332 deriveBasis …": plain job; customer buys / supplies / already bought / owner-supplied; labor-only wording; Spanish; the confirmed scope counts; the contractor buying is not the customer) and `jest/unit/professionalize-scope-basis.test.ts` ("REQ-332 …": the client posts `{ text, context }`; the picker sends raw + siblings and applies multi-line answers; the pricing screen renders the answered basis; both dictionaries carry the new basis line; the prompt forbids merging/re-scoping in en + es) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/professionalize-bullet/int.test.ts` ("REQ-332 professionalize …": context + rules reach the model; "A + B" → two lines; a folded one-liner is overruled; the stub fallback splits; single bullets stay one line; an off-scope line falls back) and `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/suggest-prices/int.test.ts` ("REQ-332 suggest-prices …": vanity job → `labor_materials_as_noted` + the customer-supplies line; plain job unchanged; fallback tiers carry the basis) · e2e `backend/src/agents/entrypoints/job-details-controller/e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-332 m30 e2e …", the app booted on the stub LLM: POST /prices answers `labor_materials_as_noted`; POST /professionalize keeps "A + B" as two lines, accepts `context`, and the `{ details }` shape flattens) · browser e2e n/a — the bullet rewrite is model output (the stub takes the deterministic path the booted-app test already drives) and the basis label is a pure render of the answered field, pinned by the jest source test.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, worktree fix/c1-professionalize-basis off origin/demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first — `deno test` on the new backend files: `Module not found …/price-basis/mod.ts`; professionalize int: 6 failed ("the original message reaches the model: Rough bullet:"), suggest-prices: "REQ-332 … basis follows the job" + "fallback tiers carry the derived basis" FAILED (`labor_and_materials`), controller e2e: both REQ-332 FAILED; `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern professionalize-scope-basis`: "Tests: 5 failed, 5 total". ## REQ-309 — Demo mode: the stage notices a lost mirror frame while the customer is idle, says "Live" only once their screen is in, and shows what the mirror counted (demo-loop cycle 1: M19, m14, m26)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — demo-loop cycle 1 (run r20a1d9c2), issues **M19** ("Stage lags 6–15 s (day change + Add task form), 3–5 s (language switch), one assistant question behind"), **m14** ("Assistant conversation list on the stage differs from the customer's for 10–40 s") and **m26** ("Stage says Connecting… for 5–15 s while both pills say Live/Connected"); RCA (analyst + skeptic, all three UPHELD, LIKELY/medium, at demo-fixes 4da03589).
**Cause:** (1) gap detection was passive — `FrameSequencer` started its clock only while a LATER frame was held (shared/demo-mode/mirror.ts:341-346), so a frame lost just before the customer went idle (changed the day, opened the form, stopped to chat) was noticed only at their next change + MIRROR_GAP_MS + a snapshot round trip ("caught up ~15 s later / after I saved"); (2) `createMirrorReceiver.push` dropped a frame `decodeFrame` rejected without telling the sequencer (mirror.ts:411-414) — the same passive gap; (3) the first op that did not fit set `ok=false` and every later frame failed until a full resync (mirror-replay.ts:245-256), the ask was throttled at MIRROR_GAP_MS (DemoStage.tsx:232-237) and a throttled ask was never retried, so a dirty stage could stay dirty; (4) the pill's "Live" came from the link status — a customer socket exists (DemoStage.tsx:540-548, transport.ts:160-168) — while the frame's "Connecting to X's screen…" waited for the first snapshot (584-601): two indicators, two facts; (5) found on the way: when the stage follows another of the customer's tabs (REQ-232) the sequencer kept the old tab's page-load id and dropped every frame of a tab whose page loaded EARLIER as "older" (mirror.ts:290), so the stage stayed on the other tab's picture for good; (6) nothing counted apply failures, stalls, resyncs or dropped frames, so which link lost the frame could not be pinned in a run. Which frame was lost is still not proven from code (the RCA's candidates: a send on a data channel that is closing, the follow churn) — the instrumentation below is how the next run pins it.
**Requirement:** (a) while a presenter watches, the customer's recorder sends a HEARTBEAT — an empty `ops` frame — whenever nothing went out for `MIRROR_HEARTBEAT_MS` (1 s), none while paused: a lost frame followed by silence becomes a held heartbeat on the stage, stalled after `MIRROR_GAP_MS` and mended by a snapshot within ~3 s whether the customer moves or not; (b) a frame that does not decode is told to the sequencer (`lost(l, s)`): it stalls AT ONCE (nothing will close that gap) until a snapshot starts over; one of an older load, or already past, changes nothing; (c) an op that does not fit is skipped — the rest of the frame and the frames after it still apply; a kept child the replay has elsewhere is moved, a missing one left out, a node said gone but still here is removed — and `apply` still says no, so the stage asks for a snapshot; the stage remembers it is DIRTY and asks again every `MIRROR_GAP_MS` until a snapshot lands (a stall asks the same way); a snapshot that throws, or ops before any snapshot, still fail hard; (d) the stage pill says "Live" only once a snapshot of the followed tab is in the frame and "Connecting…" in between — the very fact the frame's "Connecting to {name}'s screen…" uses; following another tab starts the receiver over, and frames pushed before that reset are never handed on; (e) the receiver counts frames, snapshots, heartbeats, undecodable frames, frames dropped as older/seen, frames held and stalls, the stage counts apply failures and resyncs, and on localhost the pill shows them (`data-cy="demo-mirror-stats"`, a legend in its title); (f) `encodeFrame` never drops a frame: gzip failing, it goes as plain JSON; (g) the customer's first snapshot goes the moment a presenter is listed on its welcome (already so through the transport's `onPeerOnline` — pinned by a test, not changed). No new wire message: a heartbeat is an ordinary `dom` chunk the relay already forwards.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-mode-mirror.test.ts` ("REQ-309 …": the heartbeat constant; a lost frame + a held heartbeat stalls after the gap and the resync's snapshot mends it; `lost()` stalls at once, ignores older/past, is cleared by a snapshot/reset; the sequencer's `dropped` count; the receiver's reject path, `stats()` and its reset epoch; the gzip fallback), `jest/unit/demo-mode-mirror-dom.test.ts` ("REQ-309 …": the recorder's `beat()` on a fake clock — after MIRROR_HEARTBEAT_MS of silence, not sooner, not twice, not while paused, a real frame restarts the clock; the replayer skips an op that does not fit, applies the rest and the next frame, moves/leaves out/removes as above), `jest/unit/demo-mode-mirror-wiring.test.ts` ("REQ-309 …": the sweep beats; the pill's label reads `mirrored`; the dirty re-ask; `rx.reset()` on follow; the stats chip; the receiver's `lost` wiring), `jest/unit/demo-mode-viewers.test.ts` ("REQ-309 (demo m26) …": a stage listed after the welcome makes the tab send its whole view at once) · integration n/a — no backend change (the heartbeat is a `dom` chunk, the relay forwards it unchanged; the counters live in the browser) · e2e `e2e/demo-mode/demo-mirror.e2e.test.ts` (the REQ-242 story, extended: while the frame says "Connecting to Ana Torres" the pill never reads "Live"; once the frame is in the pill reads "Live"; on localhost the stats chip counts the frames).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c1-mirror-gap-heartbeat off origin/demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'demo-mode-(mirror|mirror-dom|mirror-wiring|viewers)\.test'` → "Test Suites: 3 failed, 1 passed, 4 total · Tests: 13 failed, 44 passed, 57 total" (`MIRROR_HEARTBEAT_MS` undefined; `q.heldCount` / `q.lost` / `rx.stats` / `rec.beat` "is not a function"; `q.dropped` undefined; the reset test handed the stale frame on; the pill-label, dirty, reset-on-follow and stats-chip wiring regexes unmatched), the DOM suite alone "3 failed, 12 passed, 15 total" (after a bad op the frame froze: main's children unchanged, the kept child not moved); the extended e2e story run against the UNFIXED code (the story copied into a throwaway worktree at 4da03589; `shots run e2e/demo-mode -- --no-check --filter REQ-242`) → "expectation failed: REQ-309 (m26): the pill never says Live over 'Connecting to…' — expected 0, got 1" — m26 reproduced in two real browsers. GREEN — the four suites "Test Suites: 4 passed · Tests: 72 passed, 72 total"; the whole jest unit project "Test Suites: 155 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 1473 passed, 1474 total"; `deno fmt`, `deno lint`, `deno check` clean on DemoStage.tsx, mirror-record.ts, mirror-replay.ts, shared/demo-mode/mirror.ts and the story; the story on the fixed code passes steps 1–10 — the pill never Live over connecting, Live once the frame is in, the dev chip (`mirror f… hb… x0 st0 rs… old0 bad0 held0 …s`) counting — and stops only at its step 11 (the customer's End leaving `demo-pill` visible: "locator.waitFor: Timeout 15000ms exceeded" at line 507), which fails identically on the untouched 4da03589 — pre-existing (the story predates REQ-235's End confirmation), not this REQ's. Integration n/a (no backend change). Not done, by choice: a TARGETED re-serialization of one subtree on a failed op (a new `resync` shape on the wire) — a full snapshot is one or two chunks and the ask/throttle, not its size, was the latency; and a per-frame ack/ring-buffer resend — the heartbeat already turns a lost frame into a stall within ~3 s.
## REQ-330 — Job options never cap or drop a scope item, never show two cards alike, and an edit starts from the current details; a typed duration lands on the wraps step (demo cycle 1: M21, M23, p15-7)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo's findings, cycle 1: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo issues `M21` ("Assistant drops facts from a long message — recessed lights, permit, vanity, name, address, duration"), `M23` ("'Edit job details' regenerates options and drops the user's own bullet"), `p15-7` ("Two scope options with identical bullets (pair 4)"); RCA (analyst + skeptic, CONFIRMED/CONFIRMED/LIKELY, all UPHELD) at `4da03589`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on demo-fixes 4da03589):** (1) `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/generate-job-options/mod.ts` normalizeOneLang and fallbackOptions sliced every option at `MAX_OPTION_BULLETS` (= 12, `shared/quote-flow/option-bullets.ts`), and the prompt (`lang/*.json` `prompts.generateJobOptions`) said "at most 12" — the Henderson gut job's late items were cut from every option (each came back with exactly 12). (2) The review card's pencil (`front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx` editJobDetails → openJobPicker) POSTed the current lines for three brand-new options and selected the first: the contractor's edited pick (13 lines, "Master Bath Remodel") was replaced, its added bullet cut by the cap, its title renamed. (3) normalizeOptions de-duplicated only jobNames; padToThree's "short" variant of a one-bullet option equals the base, and the prompt demanded "exactly 3 options" for a one-item job — two cards with identical bullets. (4) `shared/quote-flow/quote-facts.ts` wizardPrefillFor handled only start_date and payment_terms, so "Thinking 4 weeks" was never offered on the duration step. The name/address extractor gaps of M21 ('the Hendersons', 'la señora Gutierrez', 'calle Elm 512', 'on <Street> <Zip>') are owned by the wizard-known-facts item and are NOT in this entry.
**Requirement:** No path caps an option's bullets — a fourteen-item job keeps all fourteen lines in every language (`MAX_OPTION_BULLETS` is gone; the prompt tells the model to group related items only past twelve and never drop one). Options whose bullet sets are equal (case, spacing, trailing punctuation aside) collapse to the first — in the model path, the padding variants and both fallbacks — and a one-item job may yield one or two cards (the prompt says so; "exactly 3" is only for a job with several items). "Edit job details" seeds the picker with the CURRENT details as the first, pre-selected, editable option — bullets verbatim, title and summary kept, never regenerated, capped or renamed — with the regenerated alternatives (those that differ) beside it; a failed regeneration still shows the current card and is not flagged degraded. A typed time to complete ("Thinking 4 weeks", "3 días", "dos semanas"; not a start offset "start in 2 weeks" nor a warranty "2 week warranty") is a quote fact; the wraps step pre-selects the matching preset (1 day / 1 week / 2 weeks) or the custom value in the wizard's language ("4 weeks" / "4 semanas"). Amends REQ-266 (the cap it raised is removed) and REQ-028's three-option promise (now "up to three, never two alike"); REQ-265's facts gain `duration`.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/job-options-seed.test.ts` ("REQ-330 …": the current option keeps 13 lines verbatim and its title; the seeded picker lists it first then only differing alternatives; sameBullets / dedupeOptionsByBullets; no `.slice(0, MAX_…)` in the island or the coordinator and no `MAX_OPTION_BULLETS` export; the island's edit pencil passes the current lines/title to openJobPicker and settleJobOptions seeds + selects it; the island fallback de-dupes; both dictionaries' prompt groups past 12, allows fewer options, forbids same-bullet options) · `jest/unit/quote-facts.test.ts` ("REQ-330 M21 extractDuration …": "Thinking 4 weeks" → custom "4 weeks" / "4 semanas"; Spanish units and word numbers; presets 1_day / 1_week / 2_weeks; start offsets and warranty spans are not durations; the island hands the wraps step the wizard's language) · `jest/unit/option-bullets.test.ts` (REQ-266 cases amended: no cap at all) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/generate-job-options/int.test.ts` ("REQ-330 …": a 14-item model option keeps 14 bullets in en and es; the fallback keeps 14 typed lines; three same-bullet model options collapse and the padded variants never repeat the one bullet; the one-line fallback never paints two cards alike; the prompt text) — REQ-026's two "exactly 3" assertions amended to 1–3 · e2e n/a — the behaviour under a real model reply needs a live LLM (the dev stub echoes the prompt and takes the fallback, already covered by the int tests), and the picker/edit wiring is pinned by the source-binding unit tests; the browser lane is out of this fix's scope.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c1-job-options-cap-seed off demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first — `deno test … generate-job-options/int.test.ts --filter REQ-330` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 5 failed" (14 bullets → 12 actual; duplicate bullet sets `["Replace a toile","Replace a toile",…]`; "prompt still caps bullets at 12"); jest unit on quote-facts / job-options-seed / option-bullets → "Tests: 16 failed, 17 passed" (`currentDetailsOption is not a function`, `mod.extractDuration is not a function`). GREEN — the coordinator int file "ok | 16 passed | 0 failed"; generate-job-options + polish-job-details + handle-wizard-answer "ok | 53 passed"; job-details-controller "ok | 3 passed"; `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 156 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 1470 passed"; `deno check islands/AsstChat.tsx` + `deno lint` clean on the island, the shared modules and the coordinator; `deno fmt` clean on the new/clean files (AsstChat.tsx left as is — known-unformattable).
## REQ-355 — The sign-in placeholder is never shown as a name; a staff member is asked for one; the greeting follows a rename (demo cycle 1, m1 + setup-m8)
**Source:** Raphael, on the 20-agent demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — and, for this run, "Can you make sure we never have to do this again?". Saving a name — in Settings or in that card — announces `pm:profile-updated` (`front-end/lib/profile-events.ts`) and the topbar re-greets the new name at once, no reload.

## REQ-348 — Onboarding has its own EN/ES switch, and a Spanish signup sends in English and Spanish by default (demo-loop cycle 1, issue m34)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop run r20a1d9c2, cycle 1, issue `m34` — "No EN/ES toggle in onboarding; 'Languages you send in' defaults to English only for a Spanish-landing contractor" (fleet-r20a1d9c2-5 stdout:50,153,214).
**Cause (RCA m34, analyst + skeptic UPHELD, at 4da03589):** (1) nothing wrote `identity.commsLanguages` at signup or onboarding — the backend only read it with an `'en'` default, and `front-end/islands/SettingsPage.tsx` fell back to `[identity.commsLanguage ?? "en"]`, never consulting the contractor's own `user.language`; (2) `front-end/routes/welcome.tsx` mounts the wizard with no DashTopbar and `WelcomeWizard.tsx` had no language control, so onboarding's language could only be changed through the cookie/URL.
**Requirement:** One rule (`shared/quote-flow/comms-language.ts`) decides the languages a contractor sends in: the stored set; else the legacy single `commsLanguage`; else the default from their own language — `es` → English AND Spanish (`["en","es"]`, "Spanish in, English out", English first so the default send language stays English), anything else → English. The backend's identity PUT (`business-identity-controller`) seeds that default into `commsLanguages` on any write when neither the stored record nor the write carries a choice — never over a pick, never setting `commsLanguage` (the first send's adopt-the-pick rule keeps running). Settings' checkboxes and the wizard read the same rule. The wizard's business-name step shows "Languages you send in" (EN/ES checkboxes, pre-checked by the rule, following the header switch until touched, saved with the business name). The wizard carries its own EN/ES switch (DashTopbar's behaviour: `setLang` + best-effort `PUT /me {language}`; `aria-pressed` "true"/"false"), flipping the wizard in place with no reload.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/onboarding-comms-lang.test.ts` ("REQ-348 …": the default per language, the stored/legacy/default order, the seed never overrides a choice, Settings and the wizard read the one rule, the controller seeds) and `front-end/lib/welcome-lang.test.tsx` ("REQ-348: …": the island renders the switch with the account's language pressed; the business step checks EN+ES for a Spanish signup, EN for English, a stored pick as stored) · integration `backend/src/users/entrypoints/business-identity-controller/e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-348 …", the app booted: a Spanish signup's first identity PUT saves `commsLanguages ["en","es"]` with `commsLanguage` unset, an English one `["en"]`; an explicit set and a legacy single language are never overwritten) · e2e `e2e/onboarding-comms-lang/onboarding-comms-lang.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-348: …" in a browser: /login?lang=es → /welcome with ES pressed; the business step shows "Idiomas para enviar" with both checked; the saved profile carries `["en","es"]`; EN flips the wizard to English with no reload and saves `user.language = en`).

## REQ-360 — The onboarding sample quote never passes for real data, and fits more trades (demo-loop cycle 1, issue m11)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1 (run r20a1d9c2), issue `m11` — "Onboarding sample quote looks like real data (in search with Resend) and doesn't fit the trade": global search for "roof" listed "Roof Shingle Replacement #9876481D $8,000.00 Draft" next to the real Q-001; /quotes read "Drafting · 0 quotes" over a SAMPLE card; the sample card offered "Resend" for a quote never sent; a junk-removal business got "Home Repair Visit". RCA (analyst + skeptic, CONFIRMED/UPHELD at `4da03589`).
**Cause (RCA):** REQ-256 made the sample a flagged (`isSample`, P-15), unnumbered draft, but only the dashboard aggregates honour the flag. `shared/documents/search.ts` never learned about it (`global-search/mod.ts` feeds `quotes.listByUser` unfiltered), so the sample became a row numbered by `docNumberOf`'s `#<id>` fallback. The Drafting track never got the "+ sample" note the Out track has (REQ-243), though the sample has been a draft since REQ-256. `QuoteCard.tsx`'s back face rendered "Resend" (its handler only stopped propagation — dead on every card) and "Copy link" on the sample too. REQ-256's trade table knew seven trades, so junk removal fell to the general job by design.
**Requirement:** the onboarding sample (flagged, or the legacy summary tag) is never a search result and never counted on a customer's search row — `searchRecords` drops it from the candidate set, so the API and any caller agree. No quote card carries the dead "Resend" button; the sample card also offers no "Copy link" (it keeps "Open quote" and "View as customer"). The sample's trade table adds junk removal, moving, pest control, fencing, concrete and handyman (English and Spanish name stems), each with its own job, line items and prices in EN and ES; specific trades are checked before broad ones (junk before cleaning, handyman last); "concrete"/"masonry" names now get the concrete job instead of the paver patio.

## REQ-299 — The polls' visible catch-up is debounced, and /dashboard has one notifications feed (demo cycle 1, issue p4 "heavy polling")
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo's findings, demo-loop cycle 1: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo issue `p4` — "Heavy polling: /api/demo-mode/active every 2-3 s, conversations/notifications every 1-2 s, duplicates" (demo-loop run r20a1d9c2, demo-report.md; RCA analyst LIKELY, skeptic UPHELD at `4da03589`).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked at `4da03589`):** the scheduled rates are what REQ-221/222 set — `/demo-mode/active` every 5 s (`shared/demo-mode/protocol.ts` ACTIVE_POLL_MS, one timer in `active-poll.ts`), notifications 10 s + unread 30 s (`DashTopbar.tsx`), conversations 8 s (`AsstThreads.tsx`), the quote preview 8 s (`AsstChat.tsx`); the agents' 1–3 s figures came from untimed request indices again (REQ-221 found the same). What did add calls on top of the schedule: (a) every `visibilitychange` → visible ran an unconditional catch-up in `front-end/lib/poll.ts` (`run()` + `arm()`) AND in the overlay (`DemoModeOverlay.tsx` `onVisible` → `check()`), and the demo's headless browser switched tabs for every screenshot — proven here with timestamps: five flaps 150 ms apart gave five `/demo-mode/active`, five conversations and five notifications requests in 0.6 s; (b) `/dashboard` had two fetchers of `GET /notifications?limit=10` — `DashboardPage.tsx` once on load into its own state, `DashTopbar.tsx` every 10 s into its own — so the Activity panel went stale while the ticker moved. (c) in the RCA — a staff with the stage tab and an /admin tab open runs two /active polls — is two documents' legitimate schedules, not changed.
**Requirement:** a tab shown again less than 2 s (`CATCHUP_MIN_MS`, `front-end/lib/poll.ts`) after its poll's last tick does not catch up — the interval is re-armed and the next tick comes on schedule; 2 s or later, one catch-up as before (REQ-221). The same rule for the overlay's `/demo-mode/active` ask: `activePoll.catchUp()` asks only if the last ask began 2 s or more ago; `now()` (a roster change, the peer dropped, the started event) still asks at once. One client-side notifications feed (`front-end/lib/notifications-feed.ts`: `readNotifications`, single-flight `refreshNotifications`, `subscribeNotifications`): DashTopbar's 10 s poll refreshes it and DashboardPage's Activity panel reads it (one refresh on load, shared with the topbar's if in flight) — one request per period feeds both islands and the panel follows the ticker live. Note for the next demo cycle: a rate claim needs request timestamps (Playwright `request` events, as the e2e story logs them), not request indices.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/polling.test.ts` ("REQ-299 the visible catch-up is debounced": CATCHUP_MIN_MS is 2 s; shown again <2 s after the last tick → no catch-up, interval re-armed; ≥2 s → one; five flaps in a second → one; the immediate call counts as the last tick; REQ-221's DashTopbar wiring check amended to `startPoll(refreshNotifications`), `jest/unit/demo-mode-active-poll.test.ts` ("REQ-299 …": `catchUp()` <2 s after the last ask does nothing, 2 s later it asks; a catch-up re-arms the 5 s schedule from itself; the overlay's `onVisible` goes through `catchUp()`, never `check()`/`now()`), `jest/unit/notifications-feed.test.ts` ("REQ-299 one notifications feed": refresh fetches once and every subscriber gets the list; two callers share one request; a failed fetch keeps the last list; DashboardPage makes no notifications request of its own; DashTopbar polls and reads the feed) · integration n/a — no server change; the behaviour is the browser's request schedule, covered by the e2e · e2e `e2e/polling-catchup/polling-catchup.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-299: five tab flaps in a second give one catch-up per poll, not five" — in a browser on /assistant, five hidden→visible flaps 150 ms apart: exactly one conversations, one notifications and one `/demo-mode/active` request, with a timestamped request log in the failure message).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c1-poll-visibility-debounce off origin/demo-fixes `4da03589`):** RED first — jest unit → "Tests: 7 failed, 22 passed" (`CATCHUP_MIN_MS` undefined, `poll.catchUp is not a function`, the overlay's handler `void check()`, "Cannot find module '../../front-end/lib/notifications-feed'"); `SHOTS_JOBS=1 shots run e2e/polling-catchup -- --no-check` with the six front-end files at the base → "✗ REQ-299 … expectation failed: one conversations catch-up for five flaps" with the log `07:08:16.724Z active / notifications / conversations, 16.882Z …, 17.040Z …, 17.195Z …` (five of each in 0.6 s; the serve log: 7 `/demo-mode/active` and 7 conversations requests over the run). GREEN — the three jest suites 34/34; the whole jest unit project "Test Suites: 156 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 1469 passed"; `shots run e2e/polling-catchup` → "✓ REQ-299 … 8.5s" (serve log: 2 and 2 — the mount and ONE catch-up); `deno lint`, `deno check`, `deno fmt --check` clean on the six touched front-end files; `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/` → "ok | 90 passed".
## REQ-304 — Publishing a quote revision previews what changes, asks once, refreshes the pipeline, and tells the customer what changed (demo cycle 1 issues M27 + M28)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo's findings: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1 (run r20a1d9c2), issues `M27` "Quote pipeline totals don't update after Version 2 is published ($9,500 vs $10,700)" (CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD) and `M28` "'Publish revision and notify customer' has no preview/confirm; client sees no 'what changed'" (FEATURE_GAP, skeptic UPHELD), RCA at commit 4da03589.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked at 4da03589):** `front-end/islands/QuotesPage.tsx` publishes from inside the open panel (`publish()` → `quotesClient.publish` → `onPublished` = `setOpenTick(n+1)`), which only re-runs the panel effect (`[openId, openTick]`); the cards/hero/KPI loader is a separate effect keyed on `[lang]`, so `s.quotes` and `openTotal` keep the old total until a full reload (server side is right: `applyRevision` lands the pending `estimatedTotal` on the live row). The publish button's `onClick={publish}` fires the POST with no preview and no confirm, although `versionChanges`/`versionChangeLine` (REQ-248) exist and `q.pendingRevision` is on hand; the public page's `GET /quotes/:id/public` projection carries no previous-version comparison, so `/q` shows "Version 2 · Revised" with no "what changed".
**Requirement:** (1) Publishing is a two-step: the "Publish revision and notify customer" button opens an inline preview — "Publish Version N" with the comparison line against the live version (`Total $9,500.00 → $10,700.00 · 1 line added`; "Wording or terms updated" when only non-money content changed) — and Publish / Cancel; only Publish sends the POST. The comparison is computed from the live record against the pending revision folded in (`pendingRevisionChanges` in `shared/documents/versions.ts`), so a pending revision that only carries the total never reads as "lines removed". (2) After a publish the pipeline cards, hero and KPIs refetch — the page shows the new total without a reload. (3) The public projection carries `changesFromPrevious` (the `VersionChanges` of the current version against the filed one before it) once a quote is at Version 2 or later, and the public quote page renders it under the headline ("What changed in Version N: Total $9,500.00 → $10,700.00"), in EN and ES.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/publish-revision-preview.test.ts` ("REQ-304 …": `pendingRevisionChanges` over a total-only pending revision; the island's loader re-runs on the panel's refresh; the publish button is a preview step with confirm + cancel hooks; the public document renders `changesFromPrevious`; en + es keys) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/revision-changes.int.test.ts` ("REQ-304 …", the app booted over HTTP: a sent quote edited and published → GET /quotes/:id/public carries `changesFromPrevious` $1,000.00 → $1,200.00; Version 1 carries none) · e2e `e2e/quote-revisions/quote-revisions.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-304: …" in a browser: the panel's Publish opens the preview with "Total $1,000.00 → $1,200.00", confirm publishes, the hero reads $1,200 without a reload; /q/:id shows the what-changed line).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c1-publish-revision-ux off demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern publish-revision-preview` → "Tests: 8 failed, 8 total" (`pendingRevisionChanges is not a function`, no `loadPipeline`, `onClick={publish}` still direct, no `changesFromPrevious` in quote-doc, no keys); `deno test -A --unstable-kv …/public-controller/revision-changes.int.test.ts` → "0 passed | 1 failed" (`changesFromPrevious` `- undefined`, expected `{totalFromCents: 100000, totalToCents: 120000, …}`); `shots run e2e/quote-revisions` with the six source files at 4da03589 → "✗ REQ-304 … locator.waitFor: Timeout 10000ms exceeded" on `[data-cy='quote-publish-preview']`. GREEN — jest unit project "Test Suites: 156 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 1464 passed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv` over public-controller, revisions-controller, quote-store → "ok | 47 passed | 0 failed"; `shots run e2e/quote-revisions -- --no-check` → REQ-248 ✓, REQ-304 ✓ "2 pass · 0 fail"; `deno check` + `deno lint` + `deno fmt --check` clean on every touched file.
## REQ-323 — The customer card back lists the customer's documents and its C-number; a zero balance with nothing billed reads "Nothing billed yet", not "Settled" (demo-loop cycle 1, issue m20)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1, issue `m20` — "Customer card has no linked documents or customer number; BALANCE Settled for new lead" (run r20a1d9c2, pairs 3/5/6; RCA analyst + skeptic UPHELD at `4da03589`).
**Cause (RCA):** `build-customer-cards/mod.ts` folded the customer's quotes/invoices into counters (balance, jobs, revenue) and never returned the documents; nothing on `/customers` read `customer.number` (the DTO carries it since REQ-198); `balanceDisplay()`'s zero branch (`front-end/lib/clients-display.ts`) was always `clientsDisplay.balance.settled`, so a brand-new lead with an open $9,500 quote and no invoice read "Settled".

The card back shows the C-number under the name and a "Documents" list, each row a link showing its number, state and amount ("No documents yet" when empty). The balance label at zero is "Nothing billed yet" / "Sin facturar" unless the customer has an issued, non-void invoice (sent/viewed/claimed/paid …) — only then "Settled" / "Saldado".

**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c1-customer-card-docs off demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first — `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/analytics/domain/coordinators/build-customer-cards/` → "FAILED | 23 passed | 3 failed" (`./mod.ts does not provide an export named 'documentsFor'`; the two REQ-323 int cases: `card.documents` undefined); `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern customer-card-docs` → "Tests: 6 failed" ("Settled" where "Nothing billed yet" was expected in both languages, no `ccard2-number` / `ccard2-docs` in the island, no `/quotes?open=` / `/i/` in the coordinator, every new key undefined in en and es).
