## REQ-311 — After signing, the page stays put and says thanks + what's next (demo-loop cycle 1, issue m19)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the demo-loop's cycle-1 findings: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo issue `m19` — "After signing, page jumps to top with no next step or thank-you" (demo-loop run r20a1d9c2, group quotes-send-sign-revisions; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at `4da03589`).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on demo-fixes 4da03589):** `front-end/islands/PublicSignQuote.tsx` answered a successful accept with `setStatus("ok")` then `reloadSoon(900)` — a blind `globalThis.location.reload()` so the SSR "signed" state took over. A reload lands at scroll 0 while the signature block, "Signed and binding" and the REQ-251 "Pay now" CTA all sit at the bottom of the document, and nothing at the top thanked the customer or named the next step (no `publicQuote*thanks*`/signed-banner key in `lang/en.json`).
**Requirement:** signing never reloads the page. The island hands the accept to its parent (`onSigned`), `PublicQuoteView` refetches the public projection and swaps the signed document in place, so the customer stays where they signed and sees the signature card fill in, "Signed and binding" and the "Pay now $X" button right there. The signed document also opens with a banner above the article (`data-cy="quote-signed-banner"`): "Thanks, {name} — signed on {date}." and, when an invoice is open, "Next: pay the {amount} deposit →" linking it (REQ-251's target); without an open invoice, "Next: your contractor will be in touch." Keys `quoteDoc.signedBanner.thanks`, `quoteDoc.signedBanner.next`, `quoteDoc.signedBanner.nextNoInvoice` in EN and ES. The stale-version and already-accepted paths keep their reload (they must show the current document).
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/signed-next-step.test.tsx` ("REQ-311 …": QuoteDoc rendered accepted shows the banner before the article with the signer's name, the signed date and the Pay link to the billed invoice, EN and ES; no banner unsigned; no-invoice wording; the island's ok path calls `onSigned` and no longer reloads; PublicQuoteView wires `onSigned` to a refetch) · integration n/a — no backend or wire change: the accept endpoint and the public projection are untouched; the fix is client render state · e2e `e2e/signed-next-step/signed-next-step.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-311: …" in a browser: sign at the bottom of the document → the page did not reload (window marker survives), scrollY stayed where the customer signed (not 0), the Pay now button is inside the viewport, and the thank-you banner is in the document with the name and the Pay link).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c1-signed-page-next-step off demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first — `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/signed-next-step.test.tsx` → "FAILED | 1 passed | 5 failed" (no `quote-signed-banner` element; "the ok path must not reloadSoon()"; "PublicQuoteView passes onSigned to QuoteDoc"); `shots run e2e/signed-next-step -- --no-check` → "✗ … expectation failed: the page did not reload after signing — expected "alive", got undefined". GREEN — the same deno test "ok | 6 passed | 0 failed"; `shots run e2e/signed-next-step e2e/quote-pay-now e2e/linked-documents -- --no-check` → "7 pass · 0 fail" (REQ-311 ✓, REQ-251 ✓, REQ-203/205/210/249 ✓); `deno test -A lib/` in front-end → "ok | 96 passed"; jest unit project → "Test Suites: 155 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 1456 passed"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on PublicSignQuote.tsx, PublicQuoteView.tsx, quote-doc.tsx and routes/q/[id].tsx; `deno fmt --check` clean on every touched file.
## REQ-354 — A double-click never opens and immediately closes a dialog; every backdrop dismisses only on a deliberate click (demo issue M39, cycle 1)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" and "Can you make sure we never have to do this again?" — demo-loop cycle 1, demo issue **M39** "Double-click opens and immediately closes a dialog (New customer, Enviar por texto)" (demo-loop/runs/r20a1d9c2/demo-report.md; RCA analyst CONFIRMED + skeptic UPHELD at `4da03589`).
**Cause:** every full-screen backdrop (`position:fixed; inset:0`) closed on ANY click and is painted over the button that opened its dialog, so the double-click's second click landed on the backdrop and closed the dialog: `ClientsPage.tsx:259-262` (New customer, opened from `ClientsSections.tsx:116`), `AsstChat.tsx:7098-7100` `.send-dialog__backdrop` (assistant-page.css:9019-9022, REQ-035 `3b59f829`). The same raw pattern sat on nine more overlays: AsstChat `.chat__pro-pop`, Settings reset, Payments record, Transfer account, New invoice, DashSidebar `.sb-backdrop`, Field subscriptions / Work orders / Work order delete `.modal-bg`.
**Requirement:** a click on a dialog's backdrop closes it only when it is a single click (`detail` ≤ 1), the dialog has been open at least ~300 ms (`BACKDROP_OPEN_GRACE_MS`), the click's target is the backdrop itself, and the pointer went down on the backdrop too (a press inside the dialog dragged out is not a dismissal). One shared guard (`front-end/lib/backdrop-dismiss.ts`) through one component (`front-end/components/Backdrop.tsx`, mounted only while open); all eleven overlays use it. Never again: a source scan fails the unit lane when any island/component/route puts a raw `onClick` on an element whose inline style or CSS class is a fixed `inset: 0` overlay.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/backdrop-dismiss.test.ts` ("REQ-354 M39 …": detail-2 click right after open, a click inside the grace window, a deliberate click after it, press-inside-drag-out, bubbled click, programmatic click, the grace bound), `front-end/lib/backdrop-overlays.test.ts` ("REQ-354 M39 …": the CSS scan finds the app's overlay classes; no raw backdrop `onClick` anywhere; New customer and the Send chooser use `<Backdrop>`) · integration n/a — front-end event handling only, no backend or API change · e2e `e2e/backdrop-dblclick/backdrop-dblclick.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-354 M39 …" in a browser: a double-click on New customer and on Payments → Record payment leaves the dialog open; a deliberate backdrop click still closes it). The Send chooser's browser path needs a generated quote; it is covered by the source scan plus the shared guard's unit tests.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c1-backdrop-dblclick off origin/demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first — `deno test -A lib/backdrop-overlays.test.ts` → "FAILED | 1 passed | 2 failed" (11 raw backdrop `onClick`s listed: AsstChat.tsx:4846/7098, SettingsPage.tsx:2189, ClientsPage.tsx:260, FieldSubscriptionsPage.tsx:695, DashSidebar.tsx:202, WorkOrdersPage.tsx:364, PaymentsPage.tsx:615, InvoicesPage.tsx:3402, WorkOrderPage.tsx:507, TransferAccount.tsx:79; "ClientsPage add modal not on <Backdrop>"); `lib/backdrop-dismiss.test.ts` → "Cannot find module … backdrop-dismiss.ts"; `shots run e2e/backdrop-dblclick` → "✗ … expectation failed: after a double-click on New customer the dialog is still open" and "✗ … after a double-click on Record payment the dialog is still open". GREEN — `deno test -A lib/` → "ok | 100 passed | 0 failed"; `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 155 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 1456 passed"; `shots run e2e/backdrop-dblclick e2e/customer-contact e2e/clients-pages e2e/transfer-account e2e/form-a11y e2e/settings-numbering -- --no-check` → "12 pass · 0 fail"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on all touched files; `deno fmt` on the new files and the touched files that were already clean (not AsstChat.tsx / PaymentsPage.tsx, unformatted at HEAD).
## REQ-338 — The "Looks right" confirm strip never covers the option list (demo m31, demo-loop cycle 1)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1 (run r20a1d9c2), issue `m31` — "'Looks right' card overlaps the option list" (pair 7, 05:51:32: "the Looks right card floats OVER the option list (covers Bathroom Overhaul bullets)", seen on both screens).
**Cause (RCA m31, analyst LIKELY + skeptic UPHELD, at 4da03589):** in "help me price it"'s confirm step the scope cards sat in `.chat__jobopts-list` with a fixed `max-height: calc(100dvh - 235px)` (`front-end/static/assistant-page.css`), and below it the confirm strip (`AsstChat.tsx`, `data-cy=confirm-details`) echoed the whole typed message unbounded (`.chat__confirm-details-text { white-space: pre-wrap }`). The 235 px budget ignored the strip's height, so with an ~800-char message at 1280×720 the picker overflowed the chat panel (measured: picker top −453 px against a panel at 126–571) and the strip landed over the cards.
**Requirement:** the picker is a bounded flex column inside the chat panel (`.chat__jobopts { max-height: 100%; min-height: 0 }`, the empty-state box `.chat__empty--picker { height: 100% }` while it is open); the option list takes the room the head, strip and Continue leave (`flex: 1 1 auto`, scrolls, a 72 px floor so a card always shows) instead of a fixed viewport budget. The strip's echo of the typed message is clamped to three lines with a "Show more" / "Show less" toggle (en + es) that does not confirm; opened, the echo scrolls inside the strip (max 8em) and, if the panel is still too short, the panel scrolls — the cards are never covered or squeezed out of sight.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/confirm-strip-layout.test.ts` ("REQ-338 …": no `100dvh - 235px`, list `flex: 1 1 auto` + floor + scroll, bounded picker and `chat__empty--picker`; echo `-webkit-line-clamp: 3` + `.is-open`; the strip renders `confirm-details-more` with `stopPropagation` and both labels; en/es keys) · integration n/a — no backend or wire change; the defect is client layout only · e2e `e2e/confirm-strip-layout/confirm-strip-layout.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-338 m31: at 1280×720 …": with an ~800-char message the strip sits below the list and never overlaps it, the whole picker fits the chat panel, the echo is ≤ 3 lines, the list scrolls to the third card above the strip; "Show more" opens the echo past three lines while the list stays ≥ 60 px tall, the strip stays below it and Continue is reachable in the panel).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c1-confirm-strip-layout off demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first (fix set aside) — `npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/confirm-strip-layout.test.ts` → 4 failed (`not /100dvh\s*-\s*235px/`, `/-webkit-line-clamp:\s*3/`, `/data-cy="confirm-details-more"/`, en key `undefined`); `shots run e2e/confirm-strip-layout -- --no-check` → "expectation failed: the whole picker fits in the chat panel (picker top -453, Continue bottom 531; panel 126–571)". GREEN — jest unit project "Test Suites: 156 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 1460 passed"; `shots run e2e/confirm-strip-layout e2e/help-me-price-scope -- --no-check` → REQ-338 ✓, REQ-260 ✓, rc 0; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on `islands/AsstChat.tsx`; `deno fmt` clean on the two new test files and lang/*.json (assistant-page.css was already fmt-unclean at 4da03589, left so). Visual check at 1280×720 (Playwright screenshots): closed — header, a card window, the 3-line strip and Continue all inside the panel; opened — the cards keep a 72 px window, the echo scrolls in the strip, Continue at the panel's bottom.
## REQ-306 — The contractor cannot sign the client's agreement from "View as customer": the preview says so, and the accept refuses the owner (demo cycle 1, B3)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo (demo-loop cycle 1, run r20a1d9c2): "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo issue `B3` — "Logged-in contractor can sign the client's agreement from 'View as customer' with no warning" (RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD, at `4da03589`; fleet pair 1: "I (the contractor, logged in, from View as customer) could sign FOR John").
**Cause (RCA):** `GET /quotes/:id/public` (`backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/mod.ts`) already resolves the viewer's session and computes `internal = isInternalViewer(session, q.userId)` (REQ-225) but only uses it to skip the open record and the sent → viewed flip — the JSON carried no `internal` flag; `POST /quotes/:id/accept` never read the session at all (public link = capability, by design) and `updateIf` wrote `accepted` with whatever name was typed. `/q/[id]` → `PublicQuoteView` → `quote-doc.tsx` gated the signing pad on `signed` only, so the owner's own preview showed a live pad.
**Requirement:** The public quote payload says when the viewer is the business itself (`internal: true` — the owner, an admin acting for them, or an impersonation session; absent for the customer). The /q page then renders a "Preview — you are viewing as the customer; signing is disabled" banner (`data-cy="quote-internal-preview"`, EN + ES) in place of the signature pad. The backend refuses the owner's signature regardless of the page: `POST /quotes/:id/accept` with an internal session answers `409 { ok: false, reason: "owner_cannot_sign" }` and the quote stays unsigned. For in-person signing with the customer present, an explicit override — `?as=customer&confirm=1` on the /q link and on the accept POST — shows the pad and lets the accept through; the banner links to it. An anonymous customer (no session) is unaffected.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/owner-cannot-sign.test.ts` ("REQ-306 …": `internalPreview()` / `hasSignOverride()` in `shared/quote-flow/public-doc-state.ts`; `acceptDecision` maps 409 `owner_cannot_sign`; the document renders the banner and hides the pad for an internal viewer; the pad posts the override; the copy exists in en and es) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/owner-cannot-sign.int.test.ts` ("REQ-306 …", the app booted on a real KV: the owner's and staff's GET carry `internal: true`, the anonymous GET does not; the owner's accept is 409 `owner_cannot_sign` and the status stays; `?as=customer&confirm=1` signs; the anonymous customer signs as before) · e2e n/a — the int test drives the booted backend over HTTP with the owner's cookie exactly as the Fresh `/api` proxy forwards it, and the banner/pad swap is a pure render of the `internal` flag pinned by the unit test; the browser lane is not run in the demo-fix loop.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, local, branch fix/c1-owner-cannot-sign off demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern owner-cannot-sign` → "Tests: 8 failed" (`internalPreview is not a function`, no `owner_cannot_sign` decision, no banner / `internal?: boolean` / `SIGN_OVERRIDE_QUERY` in the sources, the four keys missing in en + es); `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/owner-cannot-sign.int.test.ts` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed" (owner's GET `internal` `- undefined + true`; owner's accept `- 200 + 409`). GREEN — the same int file "ok | 2 passed | 0 failed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/ src/paperwork/domain/business/internal-viewer/` → "ok | 35 passed | 0 failed"; `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 156 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 1464 passed"; `deno lint`, `deno check` (rc 0) and `deno fmt --check` clean on quote-doc.tsx, PublicQuoteView.tsx, PublicSignQuote.tsx, routes/q/[id].tsx, public-doc-state.ts, linked-view.ts and both new test files.
## REQ-333 — The AI never rewords a quote's own-language line items: the base language is not a translation (demo-loop cycle 1, M24)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1 issue `M24` — "AI silently rewords line items" (demo-loop/runs/r20a1d9c2/demo-report.md; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at 4da03589): pair 5's locked card read "Demo and haul-off" / "Plumbing fixtures" while the review card and the sent document read "Demolition and removal" / "Plumbing fixtures installation".
**Cause (RCA, re-checked in the worktree):** REQ-264 made LockQuote (`lock-quote/mod.ts:81`) and the chat lock branch (`handle-chat-message/mod.ts:1179`) run TranslateQuote at lock. `translate-quote/mod.ts:44` asked `missingQuoteTranslations(quote, ['en','es'])`, which has no base-language exclusion — an English quote's `en` slot is "missing" too — so the typed English lines went to TranslateBullets with `to:'en'`; `translate-bullets/mod.ts:44-50` is a prompt with only a prose "return it unchanged" guard, and gpt-4o-mini normalized the lines. The paraphrase was cached in `lineItems[i].descriptionByLang.en`, and every reader (`quote-translations.ts` `lineItemDescription`) prefers the cache over the base. Introduced by 26761cbc (REQ-264).
**Requirement:** a quote's own language is never sent to the model. TranslateQuote resolves the base language — the caller's word (lock passes the contractor's app language, the language the chat and the job details are generated in), else the quote's stored `lang`, else the contractor's `user.language`, else `en` — writes that language's caches (`descriptionByLang[base]`, every line item's) as the typed text verbatim without a model call, asks the model only for the OTHER language (`from: base`), and stores `lang` on the quote. TranslateBullets short-circuits in code when `from === to` (verbatim, no call). Readers asked for the base language render the typed text, never a cache: `lineItemDescription` / `localizeLineItems` take the base, `quoteDescription` and `missingQuoteTranslations` read the quote's stored `lang`; the public projection, the quote document, the e-mail and the assistant's review card pass it. REQ-264's "a failed translation persists nothing" is amended: the base language is written regardless (nothing was translated), the missing OTHER language still retries.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/quote-translations.test.ts` ("REQ-333 (M24) the base language is never translated": the base is never missing; the stored `lang` is the default base; a line item / description read in the base language is the typed text even over a paraphrased cache) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/translate-bullets/int.test.ts` ("REQ-333 M24 … same source and target language never calls the model"), `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/translate-quote/int.test.ts` ("REQ-333 (M24) an English contractor's typed lines are cached verbatim in English; only Spanish is asked" — a paraphrasing stub, `lang` stored, one call; "… the caller's baseLang wins over the contractor's app language"), `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/lock-quote/int.test.ts` ("REQ-333 (M24) lock-quote keeps an English contractor's typed lines verbatim in English" — the model is asked once, never "into English"); REQ-264's fixtures now seed the Spanish contractor the Spanish quotes imply · e2e n/a — the defect needs the real model to paraphrase; the stub lane cannot reproduce it, and the int tests drive the exact lock path with a stub that does paraphrase.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, worktree fix/c1-translate-base-lang off demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern quote-translations` → "Tests: 4 failed, 14 passed" (`Expected: "Demo and haul-off" Received: "Demolition and removal"`); `deno test -A --unstable-kv` on translate-bullets, translate-quote, lock-quote → "FAILED | 13 passed | 4 failed" ("Values are not equal: no model call for the base language"; the verbatim-cache assertions). GREEN — the same jest file 18 passed; `deno test -A --unstable-kv` on translate-bullets, translate-quote, lock-quote, send-quote, public-controller → "ok | 65 passed | 0 failed"; neighbours handle-chat-message, send-paperwork-email, quote-store, job-details-controller, public-controller, ensure-sample-quote → "ok | 107 passed | 0 failed"; `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 155 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 1460 passed"; `deno check` + `deno lint` clean on quote-doc.tsx, AsstChat.tsx, PublicQuoteView.tsx and the touched backend modules; `deno fmt --check` clean on every touched file that was clean at base (AsstChat.tsx, handle-chat-message, send-paperwork-email, quote.ts, lock-quote/int.test.ts were already fmt-unclean, left as they were).
## REQ-298 — A restarted demo says so: the customer's pill announces "{name} started a new demo" instead of silently replacing the ended notice; Return as the only presenter says it ends the demo (demo-loop cycle 1, issues M5 + M17)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, demo-loop cycle 1: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo issues `M5` ("Customer never asked before demo starts; restart is invisible") and `M17` ("Second staff tab 'Leave the demo' ends demo for staff but customer still Connected, no notice"); RCA (analyst + skeptic, at `4da03589`): M5 FEATURE_GAP (auto-join is REQ-153's amendment — stays), M17 LIKELY (the leave DID end it; the customer saw the M5 mechanism: #3 started 2 s after the leave and replaced the notice).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on demo-fixes 4da03589):** `front-end/islands/DemoModeOverlay.tsx` ("REQ-235 — a new demo takes the notice's place": `useEffect(() => { if (demo) setNotice(null); }, [demo?.id])`) wiped the "{name} ended the demo" notice the instant the poll (≤ ACTIVE_POLL_MS) found the next session, and the pill went straight to "{name} is guiding you · Connecting…" — no string, state or event said a NEW demo had started. And `demoMode.returnAsk` ("Returning to your account takes you out of the demo with {name}.") never told the last presenter that leaving ends the demo for the customer.
**Requirement:** Auto-join stays (REQ-153 amendment). When a demo arrives on the customer's app while an ended notice is up, or within RESTART_WINDOW_MS (30 s) of an end, the pill says "{name} started a new demo" (`demoMode.startedBy`; `demoMode.started` "A new demo started" when no presenter is named) for RESTART_SAY_MS (4 s), with a brief pulse, before its plain "{name} is guiding you" line — a pure rule, `shared/demo-mode/restart.ts` (`isRestart`, `restartNotice`, `startedText`). A demo that arrives with no end in the last 30 s is not announced as a restart. The impersonation banner's Return question reads "You are the only presenter — leaving ends the demo for {name}." (`demoMode.returnAskAlone`) when the demo has one presenter (`returnAskText`, from the `presenters` that `GET /demo-mode/active` already returns); with more it keeps `demoMode.returnAsk`. EN + ES.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-mode-restart.test.ts` ("REQ-298 …": the sequencing — notice up → new id says it for 4 s then stops; an end 29 s ago says it, 31 s ago does not; no end, nothing; a third demo re-arms; dispose clears the clock; `startedText` names the presenters; `returnAskText` picks the alone copy at 1 presenter; both dictionaries carry the three keys; the overlay and the banner are wired) · integration n/a — no server or wire change: the end already rides the `ended` broadcast and `/demo-mode/active` already carries `presenters`; the gap is the client's pill state and copy · e2e `e2e/demo-mode/demo-restart.e2e.test.ts` (REQ-222's story, amended: the customer's pill shows `[data-cy='demo-restarted']` "Hans started a new demo" when the second demo reaches her) and `e2e/demo-mode/demo-viewers.e2e.test.ts` (REQ-232's Return story, amended: the question reads the only-presenter copy).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c1-new-demo-notice off demo-fixes 4da03589, Mac host):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-mode-restart` → "Test suite failed to run: Could not locate module ../../shared/demo-mode/restart.ts"; `shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-restart.e2e.test.ts` with the overlay's first version → "expectation failed: REQ-298: the customer's pill says a new demo started, not a silent swap — expected "Hans started a new demo", got null" (a spy of the customer's pill showed "Hans ended the demo ×" → "Connected End demo": the line was in the phone's compact details, hidden until tapped — now shown through a restart). GREEN — jest unit demo-mode + banner suites "13 passed, 140 tests"; whole unit project "Test Suites: 156 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 1467 passed"; `shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-restart.e2e.test.ts` → "ok | 1 passed | 0 failed (19s)"; `shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-viewers.e2e.test.ts -- --filter M21` → "ok | 1 passed | 0 failed | 4 filtered out (12s)" (the only-presenter copy on the banner). `deno lint` + `deno check` + `deno fmt --check` clean on the 10 touched files. Story repair on the way: demo-restart's `connected()` still matched `/direct|relay/` and clicked End once — stale since REQ-232 (Connected/Live) and REQ-235 (End asks first) — so it could not pass at HEAD; it now waits for Connected/Live and confirms End. REQ-232's wiring test in `jest/unit/demo-mode-viewers.test.ts` amended to the new `returnAskText` binding.
## REQ-335 — A tap anywhere inside a job-option card selects that card; only the pencil edits (demo-loop cycle 1, issue M31)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1 (run r20a1d9c2), issue `M31` — "Job description from the wrong card used (clicking a bullet line may not select the card)"; RCA at `4da03589`, analyst CONFIRMED (high), skeptic UPHELD: pair 9's customer "clicked the 3rd description card's line … but the draft used the 1st card's lines".
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on demo-fixes 4da03589):** in `front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx` the picker's bullet text was a `<button class="chat__jobopt-text">` whose onClick did `e.stopPropagation(); startBulletEdit(...)` (4627-4639) — it opened inline editing and stopped the click before the card's `onClick={() => setSelectedOptionId(opt.id)}` (4474). The title pencil (4558-4560) and the delete × (4656-4657) stopped propagation the same way. `settleJobOptions` (2289) defaults the selection to `drafts[0]`, so a tap on card 3's line left card 1 selected and Continue applied card 1. Introduced by 49a5d6ca (2026-05-27, bullet inline edit).
**Requirement:** a tap anywhere inside a job-option card chooses that card — its bullet text, the bullet's pencil, delete/restore, the title and the title's pencil (editing a card implies choosing it). A bullet tap only selects; inline editing of a bullet lives behind a per-bullet pencil (`.chat__jobopt-pencil`, labelled `asstChat.jobOpts.editBullet` en "Edit bullet" / es "Editar punto"), mirroring the title's. One pure rule, `optionTap` in `shared/quote-flow/option-tap.ts`, decides what each tap does; the island routes those handlers through it.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/bullet-tap-selects.test.ts` ("REQ-335 …": a bullet tap selects and opens no editor; the bullet pencil selects and edits (never a deleted bullet); delete/restore and the title pencil select; the island routes bullet / bulletPencil / delete / titlePencil through `optionTap` and the text button no longer calls `startBulletEdit`; the label in en + es) · integration n/a — no backend or wire change; the defect is the island's click handling, the chosen card already reaches the server as before · e2e `e2e/bullet-tap-selects/bullet-tap-selects.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-335 M31: …" in a browser: three cards, the first selected by default; a tap on a line of the third card marks the third selected, the first not, no inline editor opens; Continue's prices request carries the third card's scope).

## REQ-322 — Recording a payment says why it failed and confirms when it worked (demo m36, cycle 1)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1, demo issue `m36` — "Recording a payment fails with no reason and succeeds with no message" (demo-report.md, pair 1; RCA analyst CONFIRMED + skeptic UPHELD at `4da03589`).
**Cause (RCA):** `front-end/components/PaymentReceivedForm.tsx` validated only the method and the amount; with the "Received on" input cleared, `new Date("T12:00:00").toISOString()` threw a RangeError inside the try BEFORE `paymentsClient.create` ran (no request left the browser) and the blanket `catch { setErr(errSave) }` showed the generic "Couldn't record the payment." — nothing said the date was missing. On success `onSaved` in `InvoicesPage.tsx` only refreshed the list and closed the detail; the page's one flash slot (`sendFlash`) is for send failures, so nothing confirmed the payment.
**Requirement:** The form's checks run in order — method, amount, date — each with its own reason, and the date is checked BEFORE any request is built: a cleared or malformed date shows "Pick the day you received it." (`invoicesPage.pay.errDate`, EN + ES) and sends nothing; the date input is `required`. When the server refuses the payment and gives a reason (`{ error }` or `{ message }` in the body), that reason is shown instead of the generic line; the generic line stays for a reason-less failure. On success the invoices page shows a flash "Payment of $X recorded" / "Se registró el pago de $X" (`invoicesPage.pay.recorded`, EN + ES; X exact to the cent) above the hero before the detail closes. The decision is one pure module, `front-end/lib/payment-received.ts` (`validatePaymentReceived`, `paymentErrorText`, `paymentRecordedText`), used by the form and the page.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/payment-received.test.tsx` ("REQ-322 …": the three validation branches — no method, bad amount, empty/malformed date — each with its own key, the date rejected before any `receivedAt` is built; a good triple yields cents + a noon-local ISO instant; the server's reason surfaces, the generic line otherwise; the recorded flash text in EN and ES; the rendered form's date input is `required`) · integration n/a — no backend or wire change; POST /payments is untouched · e2e `e2e/payment-received-feedback/payment-received-feedback.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-322 …" in a browser: with the date cleared, Save shows the date reason and no POST /payments leaves the page; with a date, Save closes the form and the page shows "Payment of $65.00 recorded").

## REQ-353 — On a 390 px phone the app never scrolls sideways and the headers fit (demo-loop cycle 1, demo issues M40 and m23)
**Source:** Raphael, after the 20-agent demo: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — demo-loop cycle 1 (run r20a1d9c2), issues `M40` ("On a phone the app shifts ~17 px sideways (main scrollLeft=17); beige strip on /invoices, /customers") and `m23` ("Phone-width headers overlap (ES cut off; EN/ES toggle covers 'Mis tareas')"); RCA analyst + skeptic at 4da03589 (M40 LIKELY/CORRECTED, m23 CONFIRMED/UPHELD).

**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo (demo-loop cycle 1, run r20a1d9c2): "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — demo issue `M10` ("Stage controls switch to the customer's language on a demo started after the customer chose ES"); RCA analyst + skeptic UPHELD at `4da03589`.

The customer's EN/ES toggle (`DashTopbar`) persists `language` onto the customer's profile, so a demo started after the customer picked ES rendered the title, banner, pill and End confirm in Spanish for an English-speaking presenter (fleet-6:49,290; fleet-9:65,344).

Staff `en` impersonating a customer `es` → "Demo mode · DocuMonster", `initialLang="en"`.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-stage-presenter-lang.test.ts` ("REQ-341 …": `presenterLang` picks the impersonator's language over the user's, falls back to the user's when not impersonating / whoami failed / impersonator has none; the route resolves `lang` through `presenterLangForRequest`, never from `ctx.state.user.language`; the title and `initialLang` share that `lang`) — REQ-270's "/demo/stage passes initialLang" test amended to assert the identity (the presenter's), not just the prop · integration `backend/src/users/entrypoints/admin-controller/presenter-language.int.test.ts` ("REQ-341 …": the booted users module, staff en impersonating a customer es → whoami `user.language === "es"`, `impersonator.language === "en"`; the staff's own session carries `en` with no impersonator) and `front-end/lib/presenter-lang.test.ts` ("REQ-341 …": the SSR resolver against a fake in-process backend — impersonation answers the impersonator's language, asked with the request's session; a plain session / a failed whoami / no cookie fall back to the resolved user) · e2e n/a — needs a staff session and an impersonated customer session on one origin with a live stage; the identity is proven at the backend (integration) and the route's choice at the unit level.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, local, REQ-341):** RED first (base `stage.tsx`/`admin-user-view`/`clients/admin.ts` restored, tests in place) — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-stage-` → "Tests: 4 failed, 10 passed, 14 total" (route never calls `presenterLangForRequest`, reads `ctx.state.user.language`, projection carries no `language`); `deno test --no-check presenter-language.int.test.ts admin-user-view/test.ts` → "2 passed | 3 failed" ("the staff's own session says en": actual undefined). ## REQ-296 — A demo that reaches its two hours ends for everyone, said on both pills (demo issue nc-3, cycle 1)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11, after the 20-agent demo: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1, issue `nc-3` "Demo 2-hour expiry and headed-browser tab focus untested" (demo-report.md run r20a1d9c2; RCA analyst FEATURE_GAP, skeptic UPHELD at `4da03589`).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked in this worktree):** `SESSION_TTL_MS` (shared/demo-mode/protocol.ts:130, "a demo nobody ended expires on its own") was only a KV `expireIn` on the session/active/presenting keys (demo-session-store/mod.ts:42-46, 73-74, 95, 144-146); nothing watched for it — the hub never read the session's life (only `MAIL_TTL_MS`), the socket controller checked `roleIn` at upgrade only and relayed every later message unchecked, and both overlays stop polling `/active` while connected (active-poll.ts). So at two hours the demo vanished from KV while both pills stayed "Connected" and the mirror kept flowing until a reconnect was refused — a silent expiry with no `ended`. Introduced with REQ-153.
**Requirement:** a demo expires at `createdAt + SESSION_TTL_MS` and, at that moment, everyone on it hears `ended` with `reason: "expired"` and is closed — the customer's pill and every stage, in every isolate. The hub arms one clock per room when a socket joins (from the demo's `createdAt`; none for a demo already ended), clears it when the room empties or the hub closes, and at expiry stamps the demo ended (the pointers go, `/active` says nothing at once) before the broadcast. Expiry names nobody: both sides read "The demo expired after two hours" / "La demo expiró a las dos horas" (`demoMode.expired`), never "{name} ended the demo" or "You ended the demo"; a stage carries it to /admin as `?demo=ended&by=expired`. The TTL is overridable for tests only (`DEMO_SESSION_TTL_MS`, read by the store).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-mode-expiry.test.ts` ("REQ-296 …": the wire accepts `reason: "expired"`; `whoEnded` says expired on both sides, never a name or "you"; `endedText` → `demoMode.expired`; the /admin hop round-trips `by=expired`; both dictionaries carry the line; the islands hand the reason to `whoEnded`) · integration `backend/src/demo-mode/domain/coordinators/demo-hub/test.ts` ("REQ-296 …": TTL 1.5 s, two hubs on one KV — the presenter in one and the customer in the other hear `ended … expired` and are closed, the store says the demo is over; a demo already ended arms no clock) and `backend/src/demo-mode/entrypoints/demo-mode-controller/int.test.ts` ("REQ-296 …": over the composed router's socket both sides hear `ended … expired`, both sockets close, `active` is empty for both) · e2e n/a — the expiry is a server-side clock on a real KV, exercised end to end by the socket int test through the same composed router the deploy runs; the pills' copy is the unit-tested shared `ended.ts`; a browser story would need a server booted with the test-only TTL. The headed-browser tab-focus half of nc-3 is a demo-lane check (host-playwright), not a code change.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, local, branch fix/c1-demo-expiry-broadcast off demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-mode-expiry` → "Tests: 7 failed, 7 total" (`reason: "expired"` dropped by the parser, `whoEnded` named Hans / said "you", no `demoMode.expired`, islands unwired); `deno test -A --unstable-kv --filter REQ-296` on demo-hub/test.ts + demo-mode-controller/int.test.ts → "0 passed | 2 failed" — "timed out: the presenter hears the expiry" / "timed out waiting for the expiry" (nothing was ever broadcast). GREEN — `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/demo-mode/` → "ok | 30 passed | 0 failed" (type-checked, timer sanitizers clean); jest `demo-mode-(expiry|ended|protocol)` → 34 passed; the whole jest unit project → "Test Suites: 156 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 1463 passed"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on the touched islands/lib/shared files, `deno lint src/demo-mode/` clean; `deno fmt --check` clean on every touched file.
## REQ-337 — Document titles derived from a job summary are never mangled, doubled or mis-cased, and a job name may cover every area named (demo m6 + p15-1, cycle 1)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo's findings: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1, issues `m6` ("Conversation titles become document titles: mangled, doubled or Title Case", CONFIRMED) and `p15-1` ("Quote title 'Bedroom Repaint' for bedrooms and hallway", LIKELY), RCA at `4da03589` (analyst + skeptic UPHELD).
**Cause (RCA):** `handle-chat-message/mod.ts` created the chat quote with no `jobNameLang`, so `QuoteStore.create` ran the ENGLISH path of `shared/quote-flow/job-name.ts` over the model's summary — which carries the customer per the prompt's CUSTOMER NAME RULES ("Bathroom remodel — Dana") — giving "Mantenimiento De Jardín", "Panel Swap Customer", "Bathroom Remodel Dana" (→ "Dana Whitfield's Bathroom Remodel Dana Agreement"). The quick-quote front-end calls (`AsstChat.tsx` startQuoteFromRaw / saveInvoiceFromReview) ran the same 3-word slice over the raw sentence: "Deep Clean 3", "Roof Repair Jim", "Kitchen Backsplash Para". For p15-1 the option generator's prompt demanded "three words or fewer" and `clampJobName` sliced to 3 words, so a bedrooms-and-hallway job could only be titled "Bedroom Repaint".
**Requirement:** (a) `summarizeJobName` strips a "— <customer>" tail and a leading "Quote:"/"Cotización:" label before deriving, cuts the name at "for"/"para" when what follows is the recipient, never ends a name on a number, and in English skips digit-led fragments ("3-bed") — in both languages: 'Mantenimiento de jardín mensual — María López' → "Mantenimiento de jardín" (es), 'Panel swap — customer x' → "Panel Swap", 'Bathroom remodel — Dana' → "Bathroom Remodel", 'Deep clean 3-bed house for Maria Lopez' → "Deep Clean House", 'Roof repair for Jim Roof' → "Roof Repair", 'Kitchen backsplash para la señora Gómez' → "Kitchen Backsplash". (b) The chat path creates the quote with `jobNameLang` = the contractor's language, so a Spanish summary is derived in sentence case. (c) `create_quote` accepts an optional model-supplied `jobName` (tool schema + parser + action type); when valid it is stored (cased for the language) instead of the derived one. (d) The 3-word cap becomes a budget — at most 5 words / 30 characters (`JOB_NAME_MAX_WORDS` / `JOB_NAME_MAX_CHARS`, `isValidJobName`) — so "Bedroom & Hallway Repaint" survives `clampJobName` in `generate-job-options`, and the generateJobOptions prompt (en + es) tells the model the jobName must name every area the contractor listed within that budget.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/job-name.test.ts` ("REQ-337 …": the six derivations above in both languages; the budget validator; a 4-word name within budget is valid, a 7-word one is not) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts` ("REQ-337 …": a Spanish contractor's chat quote from the demo's summary is titled "Mantenimiento de jardín"; an English one from "Bathroom remodel — Dana" is "Bathroom Remodel"; a model-supplied jobName wins), `backend/src/agents/domain/business/openai-tools/test.ts` ("REQ-337 …": the schema offers jobName and the parser carries it), `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/generate-job-options/int.test.ts` ("REQ-337 …": the model's "Bedroom & Hallway Repaint" is kept whole; the prompt asks for every area) · e2e n/a — the title is the coordinator's pure derivation over the model's summary; the browser lane runs the stub model, which never produces the demo's summaries, and the int tests drive the real coordinator + QuoteStore on a real KV.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, local, branch fix/c1-job-name-derivation off demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern job-name` → "Tests: 6 failed" ("Deep Clean 3", "Reparar puertas 2", "Quote Kitchen Remodel", "Mantenimiento De Jardín", budget constants missing); `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check … --filter REQ-337` → 6 FAILED ("Mantenimiento De Jardín" vs "Mantenimiento de jardín", "Bathroom Remodel Dana", "Repaint 3 Bedrooms" instead of the model's name, schema `jobName` undefined, "Bedroom Hallway Repaint" (& stripped), prompt still "three words or fewer"). GREEN — `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 155 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 1462 passed" (incl. `i18n-dictionary-consistency`); `deno test -A --unstable-kv` over handle-chat-message, openai-tools, generate-job-options, polish-job-details, quote-store, ensure-sample-quote, quote-controller → "ok | 105 passed | 0 failed" (type-checked); `deno lint` clean on the 8 touched backend/shared files; `deno check` + `deno lint` clean on `front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx` (its two `summarizeJobName` calls are fixed by the shared change, no edit); `deno fmt --check` clean on `shared/quote-flow/job-name.ts` and `generate-job-options/mod.ts` (the other touched files were fmt-unclean before, left as they were).

## REQ-345 — The landing's EN/ES toggle reaches every phone mock, and the hero chat mock speaks the page's language (demo m3 + p15-6, cycle 1)
**Source:** Raphael, after the 20-agent demo (demo-loop run r20a1d9c2, cycle 1): "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none". Demo issues `m3` — "English landing page talks about Spanish; phone mock-up stays Spanish on /?lang=en" — and `p15-6` — "Landing hero mock in English on the Spanish page" (RCA verdict CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD for both).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked at demo-fixes 4da03589):** (m3) the chat-to-quote mock is the PhoneChat island, which reads only `langSignal` (`islands/PhoneChat.tsx` at hydrate + `langSignal.subscribe`); the landing's EN/ES buttons are handled by the plain script `static/landing-scripts.js` `applyLang`, which repainted `[data-i18n]`, set `<html lang>`, persisted the choice and rewrote the URL to `?lang=en` — but cannot import `langSignal`, so the island stayed Spanish until a reload. (p15-6) the hero's `hs-phone` chat mock in `routes/index.tsx` was literal English JSX ("Kitchen remodel for the Hernández family…", "Got it. Pulling comps now…", "Send to client →", "Send it 👍", "Type a message…") with no `data-i18n`, so neither the SSR dictionary pick nor the toggle could translate it; the doc card's "R. Hernández · Apr 26" likewise.

## REQ-319 — The topbar's live-activity pill shows the newest event, never goes backwards, is never cut off at desktop width, and refreshes on a mutation (demo-loop cycle 1, m12)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1 issue `m12` — "Topbar activity pill stale, goes backwards, cut off, differs between screens" (demo-loop/runs/r20a1d9c2/demo-report.md; RCA analyst CONFIRMED + skeptic UPHELD at `4da03589`).
**Cause (RCA m12, re-checked on demo-fixes `4da03589`):** `front-end/islands/DashTopbar.tsx` rotated through the last ten notifications by array position every 3.8 s (`liveItems[tickerIdx % liveItems.length]`), so after a fresh "John Miller accepted · just now" the rotation went on to "Quote sent … 3m ago" by design; the feed was only polled every 10 s, so a new event could take a poll plus a rotation to appear; and the pill was capped at `max-width: 280px` at every width — and, found while fixing, `.topbar__ticker-item` was `position:absolute; inset:0`, so the track never grew past its 120 px floor whatever the cap, hence "Quote sent to your c…". The stage's difference is a demo-mode snapshot-lag effect of that rotation (not this island's). `assistant-page.css` carries the topbar rules twice (the second copy, ~line 2924, wins the cascade).
**Requirement:** the pill shows the NEWEST event only (by `createdAt`, ties keep feed order — `newestNotification` in `front-end/lib/ticker-pick.ts`); its age counts up on a 3.8 s re-render; it never rotates back to an older event. A successful client-side mutation through `lib/api.ts` (any non-GET) dispatches `pm:mutated`, on which the island re-fetches the feed at once instead of waiting for the 10 s poll. The pill sizes to its sentence: the item is in flow, the pill has an explicit 220 px floor (REQ-273's "never collapses" intent, no `min-width: 0`), a 280 px cap below 1024 px and a 480 px cap from 1024 px, an ellipsis only past the cap, and `title` carries the full plain words on hover. Both stylesheets (`dashboard.css`, both copies in `assistant-page.css`).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/topbar-ticker-newest.test.ts` ("REQ-319 …": the newest by date wins regardless of position; empty → null, bad dates never win, ties keep order; the hover title strips markup; DashTopbar binds `newestNotification`, no index rotation, listens on `MUTATION_EVENT`, `title` from `tickerPlainText`; `lib/api.ts` dispatches `pm:mutated`; both stylesheets cap the pill ≥ 480 px at ≥ 1024 px) · integration n/a — no backend change; the feed endpoint and its ordering are untouched, the fix is the island's selection, a client-side event and the stylesheets · e2e `e2e/topbar-ticker/topbar-ticker.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-319: …" in a browser on /assistant at 1280×800 with the feed answering an older "Quote sent" first and a newer "accepted": the pill opens on the newer one, stays on it across two of the old rotation periods, the whole sentence fits (`scrollWidth ≤ clientWidth`), the hover title is the full sentence).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, local, branch fix/c1-topbar-ticker off demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern topbar-ticker-newest` → "Tests: 3 failed, 3 passed" (DashTopbar still `tickerIdx`/`% liveItems.length`, api.ts dispatches nothing, no ≥1024px cap: "Expected: >= 480, Received: 0"); `shots run e2e/topbar-ticker -- --no-check` (shots' own serve on a free port) → "✗ REQ-319 … expectation failed: the whole sentence fits in the pill at 1280 px (208px in 120px)" — twice, the second time after the first stylesheet copy was fixed, which proved the later duplicate block in assistant-page.css wins. GREEN — jest `unit/topbar-ticker*` → "Tests: 15 passed" (REQ-273's 9 + REQ-319's 6); `shots run e2e/topbar-ticker` → "ok | 2 passed | 0 failed" on both workers ("✓ REQ-319 … 18.5s", REQ-273 still ✓); full jest unit project, `deno test` on front-end/lib, `deno lint` + `deno check` on DashTopbar.tsx, api.ts, ticker-pick.ts — see the commit. `deno fmt --check` clean on every touched file that was clean at HEAD (both stylesheets were already fmt-unclean at HEAD and are left so).

## REQ-317 — The /invoices hero never says "nothing outstanding" while a scheduled installment of a signed agreement is unpaid (demo-loop cycle 1, M33)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." A claim still outranks it; money overdue/out/expected keeps its existing headlines. InvoicesPage feeds `scheduledCount`, `scheduledCents` and `nextScheduledFor` from the enriched list.

## REQ-329 — The demo's issues get fixed: the amount pad's quick chips scale to the job (demo p15-13, cycle 1)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, demo-loop cycle 1 on branch demo-fixes: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none". This entry is demo issue `p15-13` (pair 7, fleet-6 05:52:09): "presets $50/$100/$500/$1k/$5k — silly for an $18k job" (demo-report item 18).
**Cause (RCA p15-13, upheld by the skeptic, at `4da03589`):** `front-end/islands/MoneyInput.tsx:32` hard-codes `CHIP_PRESETS_CENTS = [50_00, 100_00, 500_00, 1_000_00, 5_000_00]` and maps it straight into the chip row (`:290`); the magnitude bar is log-scaled against a fixed $100M (`:33`, `:188`). The island takes no hint about the size of the job, although AsstChat holds the three LLM price tiers ($15k/$18k/$22k) right above it.
**Requirement:** MoneyInput takes an optional `anchorCents`. With an anchor the chips are 0.5×, 0.75×, 1×, 1.25× and 1.5× of it, snapped to a nice grid (half a step of the anchor's second significant digit: an $18,000 anchor gives $9k · $13.5k · $18k · $22.5k · $27k), deduplicated, ascending, and the magnitude bar fills linearly so the top chip (1.5×) is full. Without an anchor (or a zero/negative one) the fixed list and the log bar stay as they were. AsstChat passes the "market" tier's price (first tier if there is no market tier) as the anchor on the price-capture screen; `/dev/money-input?anchor=<cents>` seeds the dev harness so the browser can be checked.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/money-chip-anchor.test.ts` ("REQ-329 …": chip derivation for $18k / $347 / $1,850, the fallback, the magnitude fill, AsstChat wires the market tier) · integration n/a — pure client-side rendering, no API is involved · e2e `e2e/money-input/money-chip-anchor.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-329: /dev/money-input?anchor=1800000 renders $9k…$27k chips and $18k clicks through").
**Evidence (2026-11-12, Mac host, REQ-329):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern money-chip-anchor` → "Tests: 9 failed" (`chipPresetsFor is not a function`, no `anchorCents` on the island, AsstChat passes no anchor). ## REQ-328 — The /q contractor email never breaks mid-word when it fits a line (demo-loop cycle 1, demo issue p10)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1, demo issue `p10` — "Business email wraps mid-word on /q/" (pair 9, 05:34:45: "rosa@delgadojunk.exampl|e!"; pair 6 the same). RCA at `4da03589` (analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD): `demo-loop/runs/r20a1d9c2/demo-report.md`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on demo-fixes 4da03589):** the contact footer's mailto anchor in `front-end/components/quote-doc.tsx` carried inline `overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:break-all` (P-58, so long addresses never overflow the 390 px card). `word-break:break-all` permits a break between ANY two characters, so the browser filled the line and split the address at whatever character hit the line end — "exampl / e!" at desktop width — even though the whole address fit on the next line. `overflow-wrap:anywhere` alone breaks inside the address only when no other opportunity exists.
**Requirement:** the contractor email on /q paints as one unbroken word whenever it fits a line — at 390 px and on a desktop the browser wraps BEFORE the address, never inside it; an address wider than the 390 px text column may still split (P-58 stands) but never paints past the card edge. The anchor keeps `overflow-wrap:anywhere` and has no `word-break:break-all`; the closing words (`t.lookForward`) sit in their own span after the anchor (`data-cy="quote-contact-close"`).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/quote-email-wrap.test.ts` ("REQ-328 p10 …": the mailto anchor keeps overflow-wrap:anywhere, no style in the document carries word-break:break-all, the closing span) · integration n/a — no backend or wire change; the defect is an inline style on rendered markup · e2e `e2e/quote-email-wrap/quote-email-wrap.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-328 p10: …" in a browser: a sent quote whose contractor email is the demo's address — at 1280, 768 and 390 px the footer anchor has ONE client rect and its right edge is inside the card; "REQ-328 p10 (P-58 kept)": a 55-char address at 390 px may split but stays inside the card).

## REQ-325 — The /payments cash-flow chart is time-based: 12 ISO weeks of landed payments ending today, axis months derived from today (demo m38, cycle 1)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1, issue `m38` — "/payments cash-flow chart shows wrong months (feb mar abr on 12 Nov)" (demo-report.md run r20a1d9c2, pair 9 employee 05:35:41; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at `4da03589`).
**Cause (RCA):** `PSideFlow` in `front-end/islands/PaymentsPage.tsx` was prototype code: the x-axis was three fixed i18n strings `paymentsPage.flow.feb/mar/apr` ("Feb/Mar/Apr", "feb/mar/abr"), and the 12 "weekly" buckets were filled by `weeks[11 - (i % 12)] += a` over the landed amounts in list order ("Real history would key off receivedAt; for now we just slot in the rolling totals"). Nothing read `receivedAt` or today's date, so the labels were wrong in every month but spring and the curve was not time-based. The labels were only localised in b6ec538e (2026-06-08), never computed.
**Requirement:** The chart buckets LANDED payments by the ISO week (Monday-start) of their `receivedAt` over the last 12 weeks ending in the current week — the rightmost bucket is this week (the "{amount} this week" sub-line), a payment 12 or more weeks back is out of the window — and its three axis labels are the months of the first, middle and last bucket (today − 11 weeks, today − 6 weeks, today), rendered through the existing `dashboardPage.month.*` keys so they localise. On 12 Nov 2026 that reads Aug · Oct · Nov / agosto · octubre · noviembre, never Feb/Mar/Apr. The fixed keys `paymentsPage.flow.feb/mar/apr` are gone from en and es. One pure function, `cashFlowWeeks(payments, now)` in `front-end/lib/cash-flow-weeks.ts`, is the whole computation.

## REQ-300 — Demo mode: End's question never cancels itself, the pill stays still while it is up, and a dirty New customer draft survives a backdrop click
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo's findings, demo-loop cycle 1 ("fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none") — issues `M4` "End demo confirm 'End for everyone?' cancels itself after 2-5 s, so End does nothing" (CONFIRMED; fleet-7: "showed at +0.1, +0.6, +2.1 s and was gone by +5.1 s"; fleet-1:42 "the first click showed nothing visible after 4 s and sent no request") and `M20` "Ending the demo closes customer's open dialog and loses typed text" (LIKELY; fleet-9:270 "the confirm vanished … and the pill shifted position", :322 the dialog closed on the customer's own End); RCA at commit `4da03589`, skeptic UPHELD on both.
**Cause:** REQ-235 (`5c3ebcdd`) gave End's question a clock: `shared/demo-mode/ended.ts` `END_ASK_MS = 4_000` cleared it back to idle with no request sent, while Yes is disabled for the first `END_ARM_MS` (400 ms) — a screenshot→decide→click agent, or a human reading the question, answered after 4 s and found End back. And the question is a wider group than the End button, so the pill's ResizeObserver (REQ-228, `7b5114f8`, `DemoModeOverlay.tsx` place() 150 ms later) moved the pill to a new slot while the hand was reaching for Yes; the click landed on the page beneath — on /clients that is the New customer dialog's full-screen backdrop, whose onClick (`ClientsPage.tsx`) closed the dialog with "Bob / 12 / bob@gmail.com" typed in it. A slot over a backdrop counted as clear (no control under it), so the pill was also free to hop onto the backdrop.
**Requirement:** End's question has no clock of its own: it stays up until Yes, Keep going, Escape, or a click outside the question (`END_ASK_MS` is gone; `END_ARM_MS` stays as the double-click guard). While the question is up the pill's box is frozen — place() never runs, so Yes stays where it was seen. A box covering the whole view under a sample point (a dialog's backdrop) counts as blocking, so every slot is equally blocked and the pill keeps its place while a dialog is open. The New customer dialog's backdrop click closes it only while the draft is clean; with anything typed the dialog stays up (Cancel and Escape still close it; the draft is kept in the island either way). Supersedes REQ-235's "or END_ASK_MS without an answer, puts End back".
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-mode-ended.test.ts` ("REQ-300 …": left unanswered the question stays up with nothing ticking and Yes still ends; `END_ASK_MS` is not exported; `EndDemo.tsx` cancels on a document `pointerdown` outside the group and no longer names a clock; the overlay's place() bails on `[data-cy="demo-end-ask"]`; `coversView` on the full view, a hair of rounding, a header, a sidebar; the overlay uses it) and `jest/unit/clients-add-dialog.test.ts` ("REQ-300 …": `customerDraftDirty` on blank / whitespace / each field; the backdrop's onClick is guarded by it and carries `data-cy="add-client-backdrop"`) · integration n/a — front-end behaviour only, no server path changes · e2e `e2e/demo-mode/demo-ended.e2e.test.ts` (REQ-235 story's step 1 rewritten: asked and left alone 6.5 s the question is still up and the pill's box has not moved; a click outside puts End back with the demo still on) — written, not run in this worktree (the browser lane is out of this fix's scope per the cycle's rules).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, worktree fix/c1-end-confirm-flow off origin/demo-fixes `4da03589`):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'demo-mode-ended|clients-add-dialog'` → "Tests: 7 failed, 12 passed" (the clock still cleared the question: `Expected {asking:true,armed:true} Received {asking:false,armed:false}`; `expect(mod.END_ASK_MS).toBeUndefined()` got 4000; `Expected pattern: not /END_ASK_MS/` in EndDemo.tsx; no `querySelector('[data-cy="demo-end-ask"]')` in the overlay; `coversView is not a function`; `customerDraftDirty is not a function`; no guard on the backdrop). GREEN — same filter → "Tests: 19 passed"; whole jest unit project → "Test Suites: 156 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 1461 passed"; `deno lint` clean on the 6 touched source files; `deno check` clean on the 3 touched islands/components; `deno fmt --check` clean on every touched file (the e2e story's `deno check` fails on `#shots` identically on HEAD — the shots harness resolves it, plain check does not).
### REQ-300 AMENDMENT — reconciled on demo-fixes: REQ-295 replaced the pill's slot picker (`controlsUnder`/`placePill`) with `planPill`/`pageUnder`, so REQ-300's "a backdrop under a slot counts as blocking" now lives in the overlay's `place()`: while End's question is up, or while a fixed box covering the whole view (`coversView`) sits under the view's centre (an open dialog's backdrop), the pill is not re-placed. The New customer backdrop is REQ-354's `Backdrop` with REQ-300's dirty-draft guard in `onClose`. Tests: `jest/unit/demo-mode-ended.test.ts` (REQ-300 freeze + `coversView` wiring), `jest/unit/clients-add-dialog.test.ts`.

## REQ-292 — The stage follows the customer's tab it is told to follow: a re-followed older tab's snapshot is shown, a closed tab is not kept, a mid-join close is announced (demo-loop cycle 1, M6 + M8)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1 (`demo-loop/runs/r20a1d9c2/demo-report.md`): issue M6 "Stage gets stuck on the wrong tab; a closed tab stays Live; a new demo shows the background tab" (CONFIRMED) and M8 "Stage misses scrolls on the public quote page (scriptTo scroll, after Back/Forward, in a second tab)" (LIKELY — the same root cause; the wheel-vs-scroll-event theory is refuted, `mirror-record.ts` records `scroll` in capture on the document).
**Cause (RCA at 4da03589, analyst + skeptic):** `shared/demo-mode/mirror.ts` FrameSequencer.push dropped ANY frame — a snapshot too — whose page-load id sorted before the last shown one ("an older page load is over"), with no stall. Load ids are per tab (one sender per overlay effect) and sort by time, so once the stage had shown a newer tab, following an older tab again (a claim, or the fallback after the newer tab closed) got that tab's snapshot and every op dropped: the stage froze on the old tab's last frame, the pill stayed Live, and only a navigation (a new, newer id) or a reload recovered. `transport.ts` `follow()` switched tabs but `DemoStage.tsx` never reset its receiver. Secondary: `demo-mode-socket-controller/mod.ts` assigned `leave` only after `await hub.join`, so a socket closed mid-join never left the room (a ghost tab keeps the pill Live).
**Requirement:** (1) A snapshot always starts the mirror over, whichever tab or page load it comes from: FrameSequencer applies a snapshot of an older load id (the "older load" rule applies to ops only — a late op of a load the stage has moved past is still dropped without a stall; a stale snapshot of the SAME load, a lower sequence, is still stale). (2) The stage's transport names the tab it follows: `onPeerOnline(cid)`; DemoStage resets its receiver and the load it shows (`rx.reset()`, `loadRef = null`; the mirrored page stays until the new snapshot) when the followed tab changes. (3) Tripwire: a snapshot the sequencer rejects is reported (`onDropped`): the stage `console.warn`s and asks for a resync instead of silently returning. (4) The socket controller takes a close that lands while the join is awaited: the peer is removed and announced the moment join resolves.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-mode-mirror.test.ts` ("REQ-292 …": tab 1 → tab 2 → tab 1 re-snapshot applied and its ops after; fallback snapshot after tab 2 closes applied; a late op of a passed load still dropped without a stall; the receiver's `onDropped` tripwire fires for a stale snapshot) · `jest/unit/demo-mode-viewers.test.ts` ("REQ-292 …": `onPeerOnline` carries the followed cid on every switch and the fallback) · `jest/unit/demo-mode-mirror-wiring.test.ts` ("REQ-292 …": DemoStage resets the receiver on a follow switch and warns + resyncs on a dropped snapshot) · integration `backend/src/demo-mode/entrypoints/demo-mode-controller/int.test.ts` ("REQ-292 …": a tab's socket closed the instant it opens — before its welcome — is announced to the stage as online then offline, never a ghost) · e2e: n/a — the two-tab follow flip needs two customer pages plus a stage over WebRTC in one browser; the browser lane is out of this cycle's run and the sequencer + transport + wiring units cover the whole decision; the M8 single-tab scroll re-test is recorded in the evidence below.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, local, branch fix/c1-stage-follow-reset off origin/demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'demo-mode-(mirror|viewers)'` → "Tests: 5 failed, 54 passed": the re-followed tab's snapshot `Expected [snap] Received []` (and the amended "older load's late snapshot" case), `onDropped` never called, `onPeerOnline` cid `undefined` ×4, DemoStage's `onPeerOnline: () =>` without the reset; `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check …/demo-mode-controller/int.test.ts --filter REQ-292` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed — timed out waiting for tab 0 leaves" (the ghost tab). GREEN — the same jest pattern `demo-mode` → "Test Suites: 10 passed · Tests: 121 passed"; `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 155 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 1460 passed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv --no-check src/demo-mode` → "ok | 29 passed | 0 failed"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on `islands/DemoStage.tsx`, `lib/demo-mode/transport.ts`, `shared/demo-mode/mirror.ts`, the socket controller; `deno fmt --check` clean on every touched file except `demo-mode-controller/int.test.ts`, unformatted at HEAD already (lines 317–326, untouched). Browser lane, on the Mac host (`SHOTS_JOBS=1 shots run … -- --no-check`): the REQ-242 mirror story (`e2e/demo-mode/demo-mirror.e2e.test.ts`) passes its ten mirror steps — viewport, typed text, reload, dialog, Spanish, pointers — on this branch and fails only at step 11 (`demo-pill` hidden after End, 15 s) EXACTLY as on an untouched origin/demo-fixes worktree; the REQ-232 (B3) two-tab story fails at `demo-viewers.e2e.test.ts:264` (the customer pill's `strong` never clickable, 30 s — before any tab switch) on both trees alike. So the host lane's state is unchanged by this fix; the M8 scroll re-test in a real browser is the REQ-153 demo-mode story's scroll step ("scroll, drawer, page and map follow"), which passed on this branch in the first run (13.1 s).
## REQ-318 — A reload shows the thread the user saw live: no "Superseded" draft card, no re-asked Business/Person question (demo-loop cycle 1, issue m50)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo's findings: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo issue `m50` (demo-loop run r20a1d9c2, cycle 1, pair 5): "After a reload, an old SUPERSEDED card and an answered Business / Person question reappear." RCA (analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at `4da03589`).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on demo-fixes 4da03589):** the live view and the reloaded view were built from different message sets. "Lock it in" (`front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx` `lockActionCard`, `m.slice(0, idx)`) drops the clicked draft action_card locally, and "Business"/"Person" (`submitContinueCta`, toPhase `terms`) drops the CTA locally — but LockQuote (`backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/lock-quote/mod.ts`) keeps the draft card in the store and the terms `continue_cta` is never removed. Load-conversation returns every stored message; the renderer then showed the old draft card dimmed with a "Superseded" chip (the live view never did), and the reload-time collapse only hid `kind === "wizard"` steps, so the answered terms CTA came back with live Business/Person buttons (the `terms` branch renders them whenever the CTA is not `reviewed`, which only send/invoice CTAs can be).
**Requirement:** the thread renders the same after a reload as it did live. A draft action_card whose quote has a LATER action_card past draft (lock, sent …) is hidden — not dimmed — on load, in every path (button lock and chat lock alike). A `terms` continue_cta is treated as answered, and hidden, once the terms phase was entered after it (a later `phase_divider` with phase >= 2 from TransitionToTerms, or a later wizard step) or once a later terms CTA replaced it (re-lock); the server's "Phase 2 — Agreement terms" divider is the static trace left in its place. One pure rule over the persisted thread — `hiddenOnReloadIds` in `front-end/lib/thread-reload-prune.ts` — decides both, applied in AsstChat's visible-messages filter; no server-side marking needed, the server's own later messages are the signal.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/thread-reload-prune.test.ts` ("REQ-318 m50 …", 7: draft card hidden once its locked card follows; other quotes / no later lock stay; the terms CTA hidden after the phase-2 divider + wizard, or a wizard step alone, or a re-lock's newer CTA; send CTAs and earlier dividers untouched; AsstChat imports the rule and applies it in the visible filter) · integration n/a — no backend or wire change; load-conversation still returns every stored message, the fix is the client's render rule over that list · e2e n/a this cycle — the browser lane is not run in the demo-loop fix cycle; the render decision is the whole fix and is pinned by the unit tests.

## REQ-290 — The dashboard coach overlay blurs nothing: the spotlighted item is sharp, the stage mirrors no ghost checklist, and the hint reads "Tap anywhere to dismiss" (demo cycle 1, issues m17 + p12)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." The stage (`DemoStage.tsx`) mirrors that element verbatim into a CSS-scaled srcdoc iframe (`transform:scale(fit.s)`), where Chrome's backdrop sampling with mirrored edge extension painted reflected copies of the checklist rows at the overlay's edges as backwards text (m17; only ever seen on the scaled stage, never on the customer's screen). The dismiss hint is a sentence: "Tap anywhere to dismiss" / "Toca en cualquier lugar para cerrar".

(The pay page with no amount was the dev stack's fake CRM page — a test artifact.)
**Requirement:** every card on the onboarding wizard's plan step carries its note before it is pressed: a paid card says the amount billed today, the monthly price after it, and that a secure payment page comes next ("$99 today · prorated on the 1st · then $99/month — you'll pay on a secure payment page next" / "$99 hoy · prorrateado el día 1 · luego $99/mes — pagarás en una página de pago segura a continuación"); the free card says "Free · nothing to pay, no card needed" / "Gratis · nada que pagar, sin tarjeta". The amounts come from the one switch rule (`switchQuote`, shared/quote-flow/plan-switch.ts) via `wizardPlanNote` in `front-end/lib/plan-pick-note.ts`, so the line can never promise one number and the CRM charge another. The card stays a no-JS form (one press = the pick); the note on it is the confirmation.
**Not built (flag for Raphael):** the "Try Monster free for 30 days" trial — landing copy only (`shared/quote-flow/landing-offers.ts` `trialDays: 30`); the backend has no trial logic. Either build a trial in `/me/plan` (pending-trial state, no pay page, billing at day 30) or drop the landing's "{d} days free" copy — a product decision, out of this fix's scope.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/plan-pick-note.test.tsx` ("REQ-356 …", 4: the real island rendered at the plan step — every paid card's `plan-note-<id>` names "$N today", "$N/month" and "secure payment page"; the free card "nothing to pay"; the Spanish wizard's notes; `wizardPlanNote` reads `switchQuote` — a pending pick is a first pick at full price) · integration: n/a — no backend or wire change; the note is the wizard's display of the pure switch rule it already shares with the backend · e2e `e2e/plan-picker/plan-picker.e2e.test.ts` (REQ-054's onboarding story now sees the Monster and Free notes before pressing the Monster card).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c1-plan-pick-confirm off demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first — `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/plan-pick-note.test.tsx` → "0 passed | 4 failed" ("the Monster card carries a note (plan-note-monster)", "the Monster Free card carries a note (plan-note-free)", …); `shots run e2e/plan-picker -- --filter REQ-054` on the pre-fix wizard → "✗ … the page never showed "$99 today · prorated on the 1st · then $99/month — you'll pay on a secure payment page next"". ## REQ-364 — Today's loop never offers a check-in for a lead added minutes ago (demo p15-16, demo-loop cycle 1)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1 (run r20a1d9c2), issue `p15-16` — pair 8: "Today's loop: 1 friendly check-in … for a guy I added 2 min ago".

## REQ-320 — Counts and headlines agree with the data: a signed job in flight counts even when its customer owes; the public quote never says "Draft" above "Pending signature" (demo m15, cycle 1)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo's findings: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1, issue `m15` ("Counts and headlines contradict the data (0 signed jobs after signature; Borrador with PENDIENTE DE FIRMA)"; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at `4da03589`).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on demo-fixes 4da03589):** (1) `/customers` hero and the "Active jobs" chip: `summarize()` and `countByStatus()` (`backend/src/analytics/domain/business/clients-page/mod.ts`) counted the exclusive `status === "active"` bucket, but `deriveStatus()` (`build-customer-cards/mod.ts`) answers "owes" before "active" whenever `balanceCents > 0` — and accept bills INV-001 as `sent` at once, so a freshly signed customer always owed → "0 signed jobs in flight · $280 currently owed", "Active jobs 0", though the card's own `activeJobs` (accepted − paid) was 1. REQ-243 (c) only relabelled the hero. (2) `/q` read "Q-001 · Versión 1 · Borrador" above "PENDIENTE DE FIRMA": a text-only send to a 555 number failed, `send-paperwork-sms` stamps `sent` only on success (NW-10) so the quote stayed `draft`; the public payload's `state: quoteState(q)` → "draft", while the signature pad uses `deriveQuoteView()` → `pendingSignature: true` for anything not accepted/declined.
**Requirement:** (1) The clients hero's "signed jobs in flight" and the "Active jobs" chip count every customer with a job in flight (`activeJobs > 0`: accepted quotes − paid invoices), whatever their status chip says — a customer can be both "owes" and in flight; the chip's count and the chip's list are the same cards (`hasJobInFlight`, `inFilter` in `clients-page/mod.ts`). (2) The public document's headline state comes from the SAME derive as the signature pad (`publicHeadlineState` in `shared/quote-flow/public-doc-state.ts`): accepted / declined follow the view; an issued quote keeps sent / revised; a quote the server still calls `draft` shows no state word at all ("Q-001 · Versión 1"), never "Borrador"/"Draft". Decision: the lifecycle stays stamped on a successful send only (NW-10 stands; the dashboard's "pending quotes 0" is right — it was never delivered); the public page just stops contradicting its own pad.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/analytics/domain/business/clients-page/test.ts` ("REQ-320 (demo m15, cycle 1) …": signed + owing card → `summarize().activeJobs` and `counts.active` count her, `status=active` lists her, `owes` still holds her), `jest/unit/public-doc-state.test.ts` ("REQ-320 …": draft → no state word, headline "Q-001 · Versión 1" with no Borrador/Draft; sent/revised kept; accepted/declined from the view; old payload without `state` reads sent; `quote-doc.tsx` bound to `publicHeadlineState`) · integration `backend/src/analytics/entrypoints/clients-controller/paging.int.test.ts` ("REQ-320 … GET /clients": a quote accepted over HTTP (bills its invoice) → `summary.activeJobs` 1, `owedCents` 28000, `counts.active` 1 and `counts.owes` 1, `?status=active` lists the customer); for (2) n/a — no wire change: the payload still carries `state: quoteState(q)`, the headline is a pure front-end derive over it · e2e n/a — the browser lane is not run in the demo-loop fix step; the int test drives the real accept → bill → cards path and the headline derive is pure.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c1-signed-jobs-count off demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first — clients-page unit: "AssertionError: Values are not equal: signed + sent invoice → 1 signed job in flight — Actual 1 / Expected 2"; paging int: "hero: 1 signed job in flight — Actual 0 / Expected 1"; jest public-doc-state: "Tests: 5 failed, 16 passed" (`publicHeadlineState` missing; quote-doc not bound). GREEN — `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/analytics/domain/business/clients-page/test.ts` → "ok | 8 passed"; `paging.int.test.ts` → "ok | 2 passed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/analytics/ src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/ src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-paperwork-sms/` → "ok | 155 passed | 0 failed"; `jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 155 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 1461 passed"; `deno check` + `deno lint` clean on `components/quote-doc.tsx`, `shared/quote-flow/public-doc-state.ts`, `islands/ClientsPage.tsx`, `islands/ClientsBoard.tsx`; `deno fmt --check` clean on quote-doc.tsx and public-doc-state.ts (`clients-page/mod.ts` was already fmt-unclean at the base, left as it was).
## REQ-312 — The customer never sees an unsent (draft/scheduled) invoice on the public quote or invoice page (demo-loop cycle 1, issue m29)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1 (run r20a1d9c2), issue `m29` — "A draft invoice (INV-002 Borrador $600) is listed to the end customer on the signed page" (demo-report.md; RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at `4da03589`).
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on demo-fixes 4da03589):** `GET /quotes/:id/public` built the customer-facing invoice list with `this.invoices.listByUser(q.userId).then(all => all.filter(i => i.quoteId === q.id))` (`backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/mod.ts:569-571`) — quoteId was the only filter, so a `draft` invoice the contractor had started but never sent was projected (`projectLinkedInvoice` passes `status` through) and the shared linked-view rendered it as "Borrador"/"Draft" (`shared/documents/linked-view.ts:31, 352`). The sibling list of `GET /invoices/:id/public` (`mod.ts:848-851`, the /i page's "other installments" / "paid so far") had the same unfiltered copy. Introduced by REQ-205, which copied the contractor ledger's unfiltered list onto the public page.
**Requirement:** the public projections carry only ISSUED invoices (`isInvoiceIssued`: a status that is neither `draft` nor `scheduled`) — `invoices` on `GET /quotes/:id/public` and `siblings` on `GET /invoices/:id/public`. A draft or scheduled invoice stays visible only on the contractor's own ledger (`GET /invoices`, the quote panel). A voided invoice was issued to the customer and keeps its place (the shared view labels it "void").
**Tests:** unit n/a — the defect is the controller's store query, not a pure rule; `isInvoiceIssued` is already unit-covered by REQ-202 · integration `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/public-draft-invoice.int.test.ts` ("REQ-312 (demo m29) …", app booted over HTTP: a sent quote is signed (the accept issues INV-001), a $600 draft is created on it with `override: true`; the contractor's `GET /invoices` has both; `GET /quotes/:id/public` lists only the issued one; `GET /invoices/:issued/public` siblings hold only itself) · e2e n/a — the /q and /i pages render the `invoices`/`siblings` arrays verbatim (rendering of what the API returns is REQ-205's `e2e/linked-documents` story); the int test drives the real app and asserts the exact JSON those pages read.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c1-public-draft-invoice off demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first — `deno test -A --unstable-kv …/public-draft-invoice.int.test.ts` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 1 failed": `the draft leaked to the public quote page` — actual `[[…, "sent"], [bf9d9b38…, "draft"]]`, expected only the sent one.
