## REQ-293 — Decorative replicas are hidden from assistive tech: the demo stage's mirror frame and the amount pad's rolling digits (demo-loop cycle 1, issue p11)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1 (run r20a1d9c2, demo-report.md), issue `p11` — "Accessibility leaks: stage's mirrored buttons reachable by AT; amount pad rolling digits read as text". RCA (analyst + skeptic, CONFIRMED/UPHELD at `4da03589`).
**Cause (RCA):** (1) `front-end/islands/DemoStage.tsx` renders the mirror `<iframe sandbox="allow-same-origin" srcdoc=…>` with `pointer-events:none` only; the replayed document is real DOM (buttons, links, inputs), so Tab and screen readers walk into a replica nobody can act on (introduced by 9484f703, REQ-242). (2) `front-end/islands/MoneyInput.tsx` `OdoCell` renders ten `<span class="odo__digit">0…9</span>` per digit column with no `aria-hidden`, so AT reads "0123456789" per digit instead of the input's value (the `.mi__input` at the aria-label is the real value).
**Requirement:** the stage's mirror frame is a picture to assistive tech — `inert`, `aria-hidden="true"`, `tabindex="-1"` and `role="img"` with its existing title ("{name}'s screen, {w} × {h}") — so nothing inside it is focusable or read; the odometer wrappers (`.odo`) are `aria-hidden="true"`, so the amount's only accessible value is the labelled input.
**Tests:** unit `front-end/lib/stage-a11y.test.tsx` ("REQ-293 …": MoneyInput rendered for real — every `.odo` is aria-hidden and the rolling digits are inside one; the stage's iframe only exists after a live demo is fetched (SSR cannot reach it), so its attributes are pinned on the source of the `<iframe` element) · integration: n/a — no backend or wire change; the defect is rendered markup · e2e `e2e/demo-mode/demo-mirror.e2e.test.ts` (REQ-242's story gains the REQ-293 check: the mirrored frame carries inert/aria-hidden/tabindex=-1/role=img) and `e2e/money-input/money-input.e2e.test.ts` (REQ-293 check: every `.odo` is aria-hidden in a browser).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, local, branch fix/c1-stage-iframe-a11y off demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first — `cd front-end && deno test -A lib/stage-a11y.test.tsx` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed" (`.odo` aria-hidden `- null + "true"`; "AssertionError: the frame is inert"). ## REQ-340 — A one-off task's address becomes the customer's when they had none (demo-loop cycle 1, issue M37)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1, issue `M37` — "Customer details from a task don't carry over (no address; assistant re-asks type and start)"; RCA analyst + skeptic CONFIRMED/UPHELD at demo-fixes `4da03589`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** `front-end/islands/FieldTasksPage.tsx` `createCustomer` (REQ-283) POSTs the new customer with whatever the form's Address box holds at the moment the '+ Add "Dave" as a customer' row is clicked; the form's order is Customer → Service → Price → Worker → Address → Day and Hank picked the create row first, typed the address after. `POST /field/tasks` (`backend/src/field/entrypoints/field-controllers/mod.ts`) then stored the address on the task only (`oneOffTask({... address})`) — it reads `customer.address` as a fallback but never wrote the task's address back to a customer that had none. So the task card showed "8807 Spicewood Springs Rd" while /customers read "No address on file". The re-asked Business/Person and start-date questions are the terms wizard's unconditional `customer` and `start_date` steps (REQ-265 only pre-fills from the typed sentence) — that is the wizard-known-facts demo item, fixed on its own branch, not here.
**Requirement:** When the office saves a one-off task with an address and the task's customer has no address on file, that address becomes the customer's (one rule in `POST /field/tasks`, so it holds whatever order the form was filled in and whichever client posts). A customer who already has an address keeps it — the task's address is the service address for that job only. The /field/tasks page also carries the saved address into its own customer list, so a second task for the same customer prefills it without a reload.

## REQ-291 — The stage pill stays on one line as long as the window holds it (demo issue p14, cycle 1)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-11, on the 20-agent demo's findings: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 1, issue `p14` — "Stage pill wraps onto two lines at 1440 px" (pair 3 item 20: "End demo wrapped onto a second line"); RCA analyst + skeptic CONFIRMED at `4da03589`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on demo-fixes 4da03589):** `front-end/islands/DemoStage.tsx` pillStyle was `position:fixed;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);…flex-wrap:wrap;max-width:calc(100vw - 24px)` with no width. For a fixed box with `left:50%` and `right:auto`, CSS 2.1 §10.3.7 shrink-to-fit caps the available width at the containing block minus `left` — half the viewport — whatever the max-width says. Proven in headless Chromium with the island's exact style string and the demo's pill content at 1440×900: width exactly 720 px, items on 2 rows, 75 px tall. REQ-228's pillH measurement kept the frame out of the band, so it only looked wrong. Introduced by 7b5114f8 (REQ-228 restyle) / 9484f703 (frame-size label).
**Requirement:** the stage pill is centred without halving its available width — `position:fixed;left:0;right:0;margin:0 auto;width:max-content;box-sizing:border-box;max-width:calc(100vw - 24px)` — so it is one line whenever the window is wide enough for it, and still wraps (`flex-wrap:wrap`, never overflowing the viewport) on genuinely narrow windows. REQ-228's `pillRef` / `stageInsetBottom(pillH)` band measurement keeps working.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-mode-pill.test.ts` ("REQ-291 …": the pillStyle template has no `left:50%` / `translateX(-50%)`; it is `left:0;right:0;margin:0 auto` + `width:max-content` + `box-sizing:border-box` + the viewport max-width + `flex-wrap:wrap`; `ref={pillRef}` and `stageInsetBottom(pillH)` still wired) · integration n/a — front-end layout only, no server behaviour · e2e `e2e/demo-mode/demo-pill-clear.e2e.test.ts` (REQ-228's story, step 4 added: on a 1440×900 stage the pill's items share one vertical centre, it is wider than 720 px and centred within 2 px).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, local, branch fix/c1-stage-pill-width off origin/demo-fixes 4da03589):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern demo-mode-pill` → "Tests: 2 failed, 15 passed" (`Expected pattern: not /left:50%/`, `Expected pattern: /left:0;right:0;margin:0 auto/`); Chromium layout proof (playwright-core 1.64.1 headless shell, the island's pillStyle extracted from the source, at 1440×900) on the old style → `{"width":720,"height":75,"rows":2}` "WRAPPED — two lines at 1440 px". GREEN — the same jest pattern 17 passed, `--testPathPattern demo-` 11 suites / 127 passed, full unit project below; the same proof on the new style → `{"width":735.95,"height":45,"rows":1,"left":352.0,"right":352.0}` "one line at 1440 px · centred", and at 600×700 the pill wraps inside the 576 px cap, centred (a first cut without `box-sizing:border-box` measured 604 px there — the padding pushed it past the viewport — which is why the unit test pins border-box). `deno lint`, `deno check`, `deno fmt --check` clean on `islands/DemoStage.tsx`; fmt + lint clean on the two test files. The shots e2e story could not be driven on this Mac host: the untouched REQ-228 story at origin/demo-fixes fails identically at its line 143 (`[data-cy='demo-status']` never reaches direct|relay in the host lane — the stage↔customer link does not come up here), before the new step; it runs in the box lane.

## REQ-392 — The guided flow keeps a way to talk to the assistant: a compact "Tell the assistant…" box on every tap step, and the server honours the step it was typed on (demo-loop cycle 2, M7)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — demo-loop cycle 2 (`demo-loop/runs/r561db6d4/demo-report.md`), issue **M7** "There is no chat box during parts of the guided flow": pair 7 — "There is NO chat text box at 'Pick a price' — can't tell the assistant it's wrong", none on "Who is this for?" or the Ready-to-send card either ("I can't ask it to add vanity/glass/heated floor or to write it in Spanish"); pair 10 — the composer disappears while the in-chat customer form is up. Tagged STILL PRESENT (cycle 1 M9). RCA (analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD, at `deb85b35`).
**Cause (RCA):** `front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx:8748-8763` — `composerHidden = priceCaptureOpen || jobOptionsOpen || invoiceReview || invoiceResult || (hasUnansweredWizard && !awaitingJobDetails) || previewCtaId !== null`, and when it was true the island returned only the error strip (27c7565e, roadmap p.5-8; pinned absent by REQ-041 NW-53b). There was no other free-text channel, and `POST /agents/chat` had no notion of the step a message was typed on (the controller even dropped a text turn's payload).
**Requirement:** (1) On Pick a price, the Job details picker (confirm and end-of-wizard), every terms-wizard question (including "Who is this for?" and its in-chat customer form) and the Ready-to-send review, the island offers a compact composer — `front-end/components/StepComposer.tsx`: a "Tell the assistant…" / "Dile al asistente…" button (`[data-cy=step-composer-open]`, `data-step` = `price` | `job_details` | `wizard` | `review`) that opens a one-line field (`[data-cy=step-composer]`, Enter sends). On a wizard question and the review the button sits in a quiet bar under the thread. Pick a price and the Job details picker own the panel and are bounded to it (REQ-338: the picker fits at 1280×720), so there the closed box costs no height: its button (`StepComposerOpen`) sits on the left of the step's own Continue row (`.chat__step-actions` — one solid primary, one outlined secondary) and the field opens under the panel only once tapped. The big composer stays off those tap steps, so REQ-041 NW-53b (the client's "if they are tapping options there should be no input field") still holds; the invoice review and result screens keep no composer. Which composer shows is one pure rule, `composerMode` in `shared/quote-flow/step-composer.ts`. (2) The text goes to `POST /agents/chat` with `step: { id, wizardStepId?, job?, scope?, tiers? }` (validated by `parseChatStepHint`; anything else is a plain chat turn), and `HandleChatMessage` honours it; a step turn never runs the onboarding questions. **price** — when the tiers are on screen the pricing engine (SuggestPrices) re-prices the job with the correction riding beside the confirmed scope (never as a cost floor); the reply carries `priceSuggestions` and, when the correction names one price ("more like $28k"), `statedPriceCents` (`statedPriceCents`: one amount with a price cue, or the amount alone — never a cost, a deposit or two amounts); the island replaces the tier cards, puts the named price in the price box and shows the assistant's answer on the step. When the engine could only answer its generic tiers (model unreachable or junk — `isFallbackPricing`), the tiers on screen stay, the reply says it couldn't re-price (REQ-026 honest fallback), and the named price still fills the box. **job_details** — the three versions are rewritten (GenerateJobOptions) from the job, the version on screen and the correction, in the app and comms languages plus any the correction asks for; the island replaces the cards and selects the first. When the writer can't be reached the versions on screen stay and the reply says so — the heuristic fallback would split the request's own framing into bullets. **wizard** — the chat model answers with the question named in its context; the step stays unanswered (the message is never a wizard pick). **review** — the chat model reads it as a change to the quote (update_job_details / revise_quote / change_order; revise_quote is offered on this step), and a change that landed on the bound quote flags `quoteUpdated` — now also a change_order that adds a line to the draft — so the open review re-reads the quote. (3) A chat turn typed under a wizard card keeps that card the active step for Back: `activeWizardStepIdx` (`shared/quote-flow/assistant-back.ts`) skips the chat messages after it.
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/step-composer.test.ts` ("REQ-392 …": `composerMode` for every formerly hidden state — price, job_details, each wizard question, review; none on the invoice screens; full on plain chat, the details entry and an answered wizard; the panel on screen wins; a chat turn under a wizard card keeps it active, also for `activeWizardStepIdx`; `statedPriceCents` on the demo's words, Spanish, and never a cost/deposit/two amounts; `parseChatStepHint`; every new key in en and es; the island renders `<StepComposer>` via `composerMode` and the client sends `step`) · `backend/src/agents/domain/business/chat-step/test.ts` ("REQ-392 …": what the engines read on a correction, the model's step line, `stepTools`, the server's replies, `isFallbackPricing` and the couldn't-re-price reply, `stepLangs`) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/step.int.test.ts` ("REQ-392 M7 …": price re-prices with the correction and returns tiers + the named price with no onboarding ask and no quote; the named price is not a floor; a failed re-price keeps the tiers on screen and says so, the named price still comes back; the known-price step makes no model call; job details are rewritten from job + version on screen + correction, Spanish when asked; an unreachable writer leaves the versions on screen and says so; a wizard question reaches the model named and stays open; the review offers revise_quote, lands update_job_details with `quoteUpdated`, and a change_order line on the bound draft is flagged too) · `backend/src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/step.e2e.test.ts` (over HTTP on the booted app: the price step's reply — with the stub LLM no generic tiers, the honest reply and the named price — and a plain/junk step stays a chat turn) · e2e `e2e/step-composer/step-composer.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-392 M7 …": the demo's path — help me price it → Job details (the closed box's button in the picker's own Continue row, no bar under it, no big composer) → Pick a price (the button in its Continue row) → the correction is sent with the step, the box opens under the panel, the answer shows on the step, the price box reads 28,000, Continue takes it → the customer step has the box; and Ready to send: the box is there, a message goes as a revision and the review stays open) · the existing REQ-338 story (`e2e/confirm-strip-layout`) guards the picker's fit with the button in its row.

## REQ-388 — The assistant says what a customer owes (and when) from their own quotes and invoices, and answers a pricing question without drafting a quote (demo-loop cycle 2, M19 + M23 + m38)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" (cycle 2, run r561db6d4). **M19** (CONFIRMED, high, skeptic UPHELD): "Assistant can't say what a customer owes, wrongly says invoice sent, uses English word 'invoice' in Spanish" — pair 2 (Spanish) asked "¿Cuánto me debe Ana López?" in a new chat and got "El invoice ya se envió cuando firmó.", then for "No entiendo. ¿Cuánto dinero me debe y cuándo me va a pagar?" "El invoice ya se envió cuando firmó, así que no puedo darte detalles sobre el monto o la fecha de pago." — while Ana's $400 "Pago al finalizar" job had one invoice, scheduled and unsent ("Queda por facturar $400 · 1 factura programada"). **M23** (CONFIRMED, high, skeptic UPHELD): "A plain question becomes a draft quote whose line item is the question text" — pair 7 typed "what should i charge to move a shower drain 18 inches on a slab foundation in austin? explain how you got the number, and also cuánto cobro por piso radiante en un baño de 8x10?" and got one set of tiers for that whole text plus a QUOTE DRAFTED card whose line was the question ($1,500); no explanation, the Spanish question dropped. **m38** (LIKELY, medium, skeptic CORRECTED): the free-model follow-ups ("no no thats not a quote… en español por favor", "y para un baño de 5x8?") told the contractor "obtén varias cotizaciones de contratistas locales"; the skeptic found the two heated-floor ranges roughly proportional (~$19/sq ft low end) — they differ in width because each was a separate free-text model call, not the pricing engine.
**Cause (RCA, at deb85b35):** (M19) `AnswerBilling` ran only behind `boundQuote && isInvoiceRequest(text)` (handle-chat-message/mod.ts:854-861); "¿Cuánto me debe…?" is neither, so the turn reached the chat model, whose only data was the bound quote (none). REQ-368's `prompts.pricingAndBilling` told it "say the invoice already went out when they signed" for every signed quote — false for pay-after-completion terms (REQ-316) — and `prompts.contractorLanguageEsOverride` only asked for Spanish, so it kept "invoice". `billingReply` itself answered a signed quote whose only invoice is scheduled with "no invoice has gone out yet. Tap below to send it." plus a "Continue to invoice" CTA that would bill the job twice. (M23) `parsePricingQuestion` took everything after "what should i charge" as the job, and REQ-368's `draftIt` (`isInQuotePhase && !conv.quoteId && !!job`, :872) built `create_quote` with that job as the line at the Market price; the prompt also said "also call `create_quote` at the typical price". (m38) Follow-ups the parser missed went to the free model under a prompt that never said the user is the contractor.
**Requirement:**
- "What does <customer> owe?" — "¿Cuánto me debe Ana López?", "¿Qué me debe…?", "¿Cuándo me paga…?", "how much does John Miller owe me?", "what does Ana owe?", "what's John's balance?", "when is Ana going to pay me?" (`parseOwedQuestion`, chat-routing) — is answered by the server before any chat model, with or without a quote bound (`AnswerOwed`): the customer named (accent/case-folded `namesCustomer`; the conversation's own customer wins a tie; a customer-less quote made out to that name counts); a follow-up that names nobody ("No entiendo. ¿Cuánto dinero me debe y cuándo me va a pagar?") is about the name the thread last asked about (`owedNameFromHistory`), else the conversation's customer, else its quote; nobody → "¿De qué cliente?"; an unknown name → says no such customer; several → lists them and asks which. The answer (`owedReply`, chat-answers, the contractor's language) is the total still to be paid on signed work ("Ana López te debe $400."), then each open invoice (oldest due first; "is out — due …", "is overdue — it was due …", claimed), each drafted one, each scheduled one with when it goes out and when it is due ("todavía no se ha enviado — está programada para el 26 nov y vence el 11 dic"), and the part of a signed quote not invoiced yet; with nothing owed: paid up / nothing, and which quotes wait for a signature or to be sent. It never says an invoice went out unless its status says so, never bills, sends or binds anything. "How much do I owe …", "¿Cuánto le debo a…?", "¿Qué debe incluir la cotización?", "¿Cuánto debe costar…?" are not owed questions; a filler word or a document is not a name.
- `billingReply` (REQ-368's billing ask): a signed quote whose only invoices are scheduled says nothing is billed yet and when the scheduled one goes out — no "Continue to invoice" CTA; an index-1 invoice that carries `scheduledFor` was not sent by signing ("went out automatically" is never said of it).
- A pricing question is answered, never drafted: every job the message asks a price for (`pricingSubjects`), each ending at its clause — "?", "!", ";", "…"/"...", ". Next", ", and also …", "explain …", "tell me why", "¿por qué?", a second pricing question; never at a bare comma, "sq. ft" or "$1,500.50". One job → SuggestPrices on the whole message (REQ-260 floors kept); several → each job's own words, each its own block. "for <thing>" vs "to <action>" ("Here's what I'd charge to move a shower drain…"); a trailing "in <the contractor's city>" is dropped from the job (`withoutPlace`). For one fully named job in the quote phase with no quote bound, the answer offers the draft — "Want a quote? Tap Draft a quote below — it starts at the Market price ($X)." — and its payload carries `draftOffer {title, amountCents, tier}`; the chat shows a "Draft a quote at $X" button (`[data-cy=msg-draft-offer]`) on the newest message only, while no quote is bound (`liveDraftOffer`, shared/quote-flow/chat-draft-offer.ts); pressing it sends those words, and the server (`parseDraftRequest`: the button's en/es words, "draft it", "draft it at $3,100", "sí, prepárala") drafts that job at the price asked for, else the offered one — the only way a pricing question becomes a quote. Several jobs, a follow-up, or a bound quote → no offer (a bound open draft keeps REQ-368's "Tell me which one you want and I'll update the quote.").
- "Explain how you got the number" / "why" / "¿por qué?" (`asksHowPriced`): the chat model writes the answer from the engine's tiers (businessContext: every job's tiers), with no tools and `prompts.pricingExplain` (use exactly those numbers, advise the contractor, never draft); if it gives nothing, the tier answer stands.
- A pricing follow-up right after a pricing answer — "y para un baño de 5x8?", "and for a 5x8 one?", "what about a 12x12 room?" (`parsePricingFollowUp`; never "y para cuándo…?", "and in Spanish?") — is priced by SuggestPrices, not the chat model; every pricing call in a thread that already had prices passes them as `context` ("keep the new prices consistent… they are suggestions, not the contractor's costs"), never part of the cost floor.
- Prompts (en + es dictionaries identical): `prompts.pricingAndBilling` says the user is the contractor ("you advise them on what to CHARGE their customer… never tell them to get quotes or bids from other contractors"), keep consistent with prices already given, "don't draft a quote unless the contractor asks for one" (the "also call `create_quote` at the typical price" line is gone), and INVOICES follow the payment terms — a deposit/first payment is billed at signing, "payment upon completion" / "Net N" after the job (scheduled, nothing goes out at signing); "never say an invoice went out unless the invoice data says so". `prompts.contractorLanguageEsOverride` adds the glossary: 'factura' (never 'invoice'), 'cotización' (never 'quote'), 'depósito' (never 'deposit'), 'orden de cambio' (never 'change order'). All new copy in en and es.
**Supersedes:** REQ-368's "in the quote phase with no quote yet a draft at the Market price" (and `chatCoordinator.pricing.drafted`, removed) and its prompt line "say the invoice already went out when they signed" — see the REQ-368 AMENDMENT below.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/chat-routing/test.ts` (12 "REQ-388 …": pair 7's text and the customer's quoted "slab..." version → the clipped job; `pricingSubjects` → the drain move (action) + the heated floor; clause boundaries and non-boundaries; `asksHowPriced`; `parsePricingFollowUp` incl. "y para un baño de 5x8?" and its negatives; `parseOwedQuestion` on pair 2's two sentences, other EN/ES phrasings, and the negatives incl. "¿Qué debe incluir la cotización?" / "Bueno, ¿cuánto me debe?"; `owedNameFromHistory`; `parseDraftRequest` incl. the button's own en/es words; `withoutPlace`) · `backend/src/agents/domain/business/chat-answers/test.ts` (6 "REQ-388 …" + the REQ-368 tier test, now "REQ-368 M30 + REQ-388 M23", offering: two-job reply, pair 2's Ana in Spanish ($400, INV-001, programada, 26 nov, 11 dic, no "invoice", no "se envió"), pair 1's John ($3,200, INV-001 out, INV-002 scheduled), overdue / paid up / unbilled / unsigned / void, `billingReply` scheduled-only and sent-later) · `backend/src/agents/domain/business/llm-prompts/test.ts` (4 "REQ-388 …": contractor-advice rule, no create_quote from a question, invoices follow the terms and the data, the ES glossary in both dictionaries) · `jest/unit/chat-draft-offer.test.ts` (10 "REQ-388 …": `draftOfferOf`, `liveDraftOffer`, `offerAmount`, the AsstChat button wiring, the en/es label) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/owed-pricing.int.test.ts` (9: M19 pair 2's question in a new chat and its follow-up with no chat-model call, Ana's own thread / unknown name / nobody, pair 1's John in English; M23 pair 7's question → two separate pricing calls, the explanation with tools [] and both jobs' tiers in its context, no quote; one job → tiers + `draftOffer`, "Draft a quote at $2,400" drafts "Move a shower drain 18 inches on a slab foundation"; "draft it at $3,100"; m38 "y para un baño de 5x8?" → the pricing engine with the earlier tiers as context, no offer; "…en español por favor" reaches the model with the contractor rule) · `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/suggest-prices/int.test.ts` ("REQ-388 m38 …": context reaches the model and is never a floor) · `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/intent.int.test.ts` (the REQ-368 M30 test, now "REQ-368 M30 + REQ-388 M23": tiers + offer, no quote) · e2e (HTTP) `backend/src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/owed-pricing.e2e.test.ts` (2: M19 — Ana signs a "Payment upon completion" quote through the public accept, which schedules INV-001; ## REQ-400 — Job details read the same in every language, and every job-option version is the whole job without the customer in it (demo-loop cycle 2, issues M5, M21, m32)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the demo loop: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (`demo-loop/runs/r561db6d4/demo-report.md`), issues `M5` — "Quote documents mix the two languages" ("Maria Lopez's Reparación de puerta Agreement", pair 6; "Acuerdo de Roof Replacement de Dave Roof", pair 4; "After 'Edit job details' the English preview showed three Spanish bullets, then three English ones", pair 7), `M21` — "Each job-description 'version' holds only part of the job; editing drops the rest" ("the 3 versions each hold only 1/3 of the scope"; "after 'Edit job details' all four options were the same three items reworded", pair 7), `m32` — "The customer's name used as scope items: 'Servicio para Ana López' made it onto the sent quote" (pair 2); RCA at demo-fixes `deb85b35`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on demo-fixes deb85b35):** M5 — `TranslateQuote` (`backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/translate-quote/mod.ts`) filled `descriptionByLang` and the lines' `descriptionByLang` but never `jobNameByLang` / `summaryByLang`, while every reader (quote-doc title and recital, e-mail subject, SMS, PDF, `/i`, the public redaction) prefers `jobNameByLang?.[lang] ?? jobName` — only the picker ever wrote them, so a chat quote or a one-language pick titled the other language's document in the base language. And `AsstChat.tsx` `editJobDetails` seeded the picker with `jobDetailRows` — the rows the card was showing in the PREVIEW language — and `applyJobOption` stores the picked card's lines as the app-language description, so with the toggle on Español the English description became three Spanish lines. M21 — the options prompt's output example (`lang/*.json` `prompts.generateJobOptions` and the coordinator's `optionShape`) gave every option exactly three bullets, the rules said "never return two options with the same bullets", and nothing on the server checked that an option covers the job, so a nine-item gut came back as three thirds; the padding/fallback "short version" sliced the job (`slice(0, len - 1)`, `base.slice(0, 3)`); and the edit regenerated from the current bullets alone (`jobPolishRawRef.current = lines.join("\n")`). m32 — nothing filtered a model bullet that names the customer, their contact or the job's duration (`normalizeOneLang` only dropped money), and the heuristic fallback bulleted "… para Ana López, 4 semanas" as typed.
**Requirement:** (M5) TranslateQuote translates the job name and the summary with the lines — the base language's slot is the typed text verbatim (the name cased by `jobNameCase`), every other language through TranslateBullets in the same call, a translated name cased for its language (`translatedJobNameCase`: English Title Case, Spanish sentence case) — into `jobNameByLang` / `summaryByLang`; a failed translation caches nothing; renaming the job (or changing the summary) without new per-language text drops the stale map (`QuoteStore.update`, `headingTranslationsStale`). "Edit job details" seeds the picker with the quote's OWN lines (`quote.description`, else the lock card's copy, else the line items' own text — `shared/quote-flow/edit-job-details.ts` `editJobDetailsSeed`), never the preview language's rows; `applyJobOption` is unchanged. (M21) Every option is a version of the WHOLE job: no fixed-length bullets example anywhere; the prompt says every option covers every scope item and options differ only in wording and grouping; the coordinator judges each reply (`partitionByCoverage` — an option leaving out more than one in five of the reply's distinct items is a part; and the most detailed option holding fewer than half of the typed items), asks again ONCE with the job's items listed (`prompts.generateJobOptions.coverageRetry`) and keeps the better reply, drops the options that are parts, and merges the parts into one whole-job version when none is whole; the "short version" groups every item two to a line (`groupedBullets`) in the coordinator's padding, its fallback and the island's last-resort fallback. The edit regenerates from the message the contractor typed (kept as `originalRaw` on the REQ-230 flow draft, set in `submitJobDetails`) plus the current lines. (m32) A bullet is scope, never the customer: `cleanScopeBullet` drops customer / contact / duration labels, "Servicio para / Service for <Name>", the typed customer's name alone, a phone or e-mail, a duration on its own, and strips the name from a scope line ("Weekly lawn mowing for Ana López" → "Weekly lawn mowing"); the fallbacks strip the name, contact and a ", 4 semanas" part from the typed lines (`stripCustomerDetails`); the prompt forbids them too.

## REQ-391 — Demo mode: the stage says "Live" only when its frame is the customer's screen in time — "Loading their next page…" between pages, "Catching up…" / "Behind N s" when late — notices a closed customer tab at once, and its waiting notice is a banner across the frame's top (demo-loop cycle 2: M4, m21)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none" — demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4), issues **M4** ("The stage runs 5–15 s behind while still saying 'Live'": pairs 3, 5, 7 — "an assistant reply reached the stage ~7.6 s after the message vs ~1.75 s"; expected "about a second, or a sign that the stage is behind") and **m21** ("The stage takes 5–10 s to notice the customer's tab is gone ('Live' at 4.3 s, dimmed by ~13 s), and the 'Waiting…' card sits on top of page text", pair 10); RCA (analyst + skeptic at demo-fixes deb85b35: M4 CORRECTED → LIKELY/medium, m21 UPHELD → CONFIRMED/high).
**Cause (re-checked at deb85b35):** (1) "Live" meant only that SOME snapshot was in the frame (REQ-309, `DemoStage.tsx` statusLabel: live iff direct|relay && mirrored), and the 5 s presence grace (REQ-232, `transport.ts` startGrace/tabLeft; `PRESENCE_GRACE_MS`) counted a gone tab as still online — so a full page change (the assistant's `location.href = /assistant/<id>`) kept "Live" over the OLD page while the new one loaded, joined and snapshotted (pair 5), and a closed tab kept "Live" for 5 s before "waiting" (pair 10: "Live" at 4.3 s); (2) after a follow switch the old tab's picture stayed under "Live" until the new tab's snapshot; (3) frames carried no send time, so how late the stage was could not be measured or said (pair 7's 7.6 s vs 1.75 s is, per the skeptic, a measurement artefact of the agents' clocks — and pair 3's ~5 s in-page delay stays unexplained without a timestamp); (4) the waiting notice was a card centred over the whole frame box (`${box}` + `place-items:center`, an 85 %-opaque panel). Proven, not assumed (Chromium, playwright-core 1.64.1 headless shell 1248): the Navigation API `navigate` event fires BEFORE `pagehide` for a link click, `location.href`, `location.reload()`, `history.back()` and the browser's Back button — never for `page.goto` (the address bar), `page.reload` (the reload button) or `page.close`; `visibilityState` is "visible" at `pagehide` in every case (useless to tell a close); a WebSocket message sent in `pagehide` reached the server BEFORE the socket's close (code 1001) in 20/20 runs (link, goto, close) and every reload.
**Requirement:** (a) the customer's page says, as it goes (`pagehide`), WHY: `leaving: navigating` when it saw a navigation to another document of the app start (the Navigation API; without it, a plain unprevented click on a same-origin link or a form sent; a keyboard reload F5/Ctrl+R/Cmd+R) and `leaving: closing` otherwise (`front-end/lib/demo-mode/leave-hint.ts`); the server keeps it on the socket and stamps it on that tab's departure (`peer … online:false, why`), in every isolate; (b) a stage whose last customer tab went: `closing` → "waiting" AT ONCE (no grace); `navigating` → a status of its own, `between` ("Loading their next page…"), for PRESENCE_GRACE_MS while the next page comes; a socket gone without a word (a crash, a lost network, a page from before) → `between` for SILENT_GRACE_MS (2 s), then "waiting"; another tab still there → no grace (REQ-232's fallback, unchanged); (c) the pill's words come from `stageStatus` (shared/demo-mode/stage-frame.ts), most wrong first: ended · "Open in another window" · "Waiting for {name}'s app…" · "Connecting…" (no snapshot yet) · "Loading their next page…" (`between`, or a newly followed tab's snapshot not in yet) · "Catching up…" (a resync asked and not in) · "Behind N s" (frames arriving over LAG_BEHIND_MS = 1.5 s late; back to "Live" under LAG_LIVE_MS = 1 s) · "Live"; (d) every mirror chunk carries its frame's PUSH time on the deploy's clock (`t`); each browser learns its offset to that clock from a `time` round trip after the welcome (Cristian: the deploy's time + half the round trip, the shortest trip kept) — `link.now()`; the receiver measures every frame it hands on (push → handed on) and every frame as its last chunk lands (push → in: the encoder and the wire alone) and keeps the last, the median and the worst of the last 200 (`rx.lag()`); on localhost the stats chip shows `lag p50/max s · net p50/max s · p2p|ws`, so the next run pins which hop is slow; (e) the waiting notice is a banner across the frame's top edge (the frame's width, its top, pointer-events none), never a card over the middle of their page; the frame between pages keeps its look unless it is already the stale screen (then dimmed under the banner, REQ-297).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-stage-live.test.ts` ("REQ-391 …": the wire — `leaving`/`time` parse, `peer.why` on departures only, a chunk's `t` kept, a bad one dropped never the chunk; the mirror — every chunk stamped at push, not at encode; the receiver's last/median/worst of the whole path and of the wire, a held frame late in the first and not the second; no time → no sample; a clock a little behind → 0; reset; the bounded window; the stage's link on a fake socket — closing → waiting at once, navigating → between then relay with no waiting, navigating with no next page → waiting after PRESENCE_GRACE_MS, silent → waiting after SILENT_GRACE_MS, another tab → no grace; the `time` round trip sets `now()` and a slower trip never replaces a better one; the customer's `leaving()` on the socket; `stageStatus` and `behindSeconds` tables incl. the hysteresis; the frame's look between pages; the leave hint — Navigation API (another page, a reload, not same-document, not cross-origin/about:blank, not a download, a failed or stale one forgotten), the click/submit stand-in without it, the keyboard reload, `stop()`; the wiring of DemoStage/DemoModeOverlay; the words in en and es), `backend/src/demo-mode/domain/coordinators/demo-hub/test.ts` ("REQ-391 a tab that said why it goes is announced gone with that reason, in this hub and across hubs; one that said nothing without one") · integration `backend/src/demo-mode/entrypoints/demo-mode-controller/int.test.ts` ("REQ-391 (demo-loop cycle 2, M4 + m21) over the composed router's socket: …" — navigating, closing, silent and junk departures; `time` answered with the deploy's clock; a `leaving` never relayed) · e2e `e2e/demo-mode/demo-stage-live.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-391 …": an in-app page change says "Loading their next page…", never Live over the old page and never Waiting, then Live on the new page; the dev chip measures lag and net; the customer's tab to about:blank — the demo agent's "closed the tab" — is "Waiting for Ana Torres's app…" within 2.5 s, under a banner flush with the frame's top edge and under 20 % of its height; back on /dashboard it is Live and the banner gone).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c2-stage-live-status off origin/demo-fixes deb85b35):** RED first — `cd jest && npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern 'demo-stage-live|demo-mode-viewers|demo-mode-mirror-wiring'` → "Cannot find module '../../front-end/lib/demo-mode/leave-hint'", the amended REQ-232 transport test "Expected: \"between\" Received: \"relay\"", the amended REQ-309 wiring regex unmatched; with a not-implemented scaffold for the hint module, the new suite "Tests: 31 failed, 1 passed, 32 total" — m21 "closing … Expected: \"waiting\" Received: \"relay\"", M4 "navigating … Expected: \"between\" Received: \"relay\"", "rx.lag is not a function", "link.leaving is not a function", "stageStatus is not a function", the waiting block matched `place-items:center` (the 1 pass: another tab still there → no grace, REQ-232's existing behaviour). Backend type check "Found 11 errors" (Peer.leaving, peer.why, time); at runtime (`--no-check`) "FAILED | 24 passed | 2 failed" — the hub's departure lacked `why: "navigating"`, the socket "timed out waiting for the deploy's time". e2e on the unfixed app (`SHOTS_JOBS=1 shots run e2e/demo-mode/demo-stage-live.e2e.test.ts -- --no-check`) → "expectation failed: REQ-391: M4: the pill never said their next page was loading — it stayed [\"Live\"] | M4: the dev chip measures no lag (\"mirror f8 hb4 x0 st0 rs0 old0 bad0 held0 0.2s\") | m21: the stage noticed after 5025 ms (wanted ≤ 2 500 ms; seen [\"Live\",\"Waiting for Ana Torres's app…\"]) | m21: the waiting notice is not a banner across the frame's top edge ({\"top\":0,\"left\":0,\"width\":-0.0093994140625,\"height\":668.5,\"frameHeight\":668.5})" — M4 and m21 reproduced in two real browsers. GREEN — the jest demo suites "Test Suites: 18 passed · Tests: 259 passed" (227 before + 32); the whole jest unit project "Test Suites: 209 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2033 passed, 2034 total"; `cd backend && deno test -A --unstable-kv src/demo-mode/` (type-checked) "ok | 38 passed | 0 failed"; the REQ-391 story ✓; a throwaway diagnostic copy recorded the M4 statuses ["Live","Loading their next page…","Live"], "Waiting…" 7 ms after the tab went to about:blank, the banner {top 0, left 0, width −0.009, height 49.75 of 668.5}, the chip "… lag 0.0/0.0s net 0.0/0.0s ws". Neighbours — `shots run e2e/demo-mode` on deb85b35 and on the fix back to back (SHOTS_JOBS 2, host load ~30): base "6 pass · 7 fail", fix "7 pass · 7 fail" — the SAME seven with the same reasons on both (REQ-228/291 the pill "DocuMonster" @640,45; REQ-232 B3 `locator.click` 30 s; m3 and p1 `locator.waitFor` 15 s; REQ-235/300 `waitFor` 20 s; REQ-242 `waitFor` 15 s; REQ-305 M7 "the quote page has the sign form's name field … expected 1, got 0") — pre-existing on demo-fixes, not this REQ's; the amended REQ-232 m1 story ✓ on both. `deno fmt --check` clean on every touched file (each was clean at HEAD), `deno lint` clean (front-end, backend/src/demo-mode + shared/demo-mode, the story and the jest file), `deno check` clean on DemoStage, DemoModeOverlay, transport, leave-hint, every other front-end importer of the demo protocol and backend `src/demo-mode/mod-root.ts`. Deliberate trade-off, measured: a page changed from OUTSIDE the app (the address bar, a bookmark, the reload button — `page.goto` in a story) cannot be told from leaving the app at `pagehide`; the original goto-based m1 story now sees ["Waiting for Ana Torres's app…","Loading their next page…","Live", …] per change — the stage says it is waiting until that page joins, then recovers on its own. Not done, by choice: a "behind" from silence alone (no frame at all for a while) — a hidden customer tab's throttled heartbeats would raise it falsely, and REQ-309's held-heartbeat stall already turns a lost frame into "Catching up…"; keeping the stage on a navigating tab instead of REQ-232's fallback to another open tab. Open: which hop delayed pair 3's in-page frames is now measurable (`lag` vs `net`, `p2p` vs `ws` on the dev chip) but needs the next demo run.

## REQ-393 — The presenter's pointer is the spot under his mouse, wherever it is on the stage: looked up again on every layout pass, there from the start, taken off the tab the stage leaves, and on the edge of the customer's screen when his mouse is beside the frame (demo M2, M8 — cycle 2)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4, `demo-loop/runs/r561db6d4/demo-report.md`): **M2** — "Presenter's resting pointer wrong place or missing after customer scrolls / switches tab / demo restart" (pairs 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10; STILL PRESENT from cycle 1 M2; pair 3's employee and customer disagreed about where the arrow was) and **M8** — "At phone size presenter pointer vanishes when his mouse is outside the phone frame, no warning" (pair 8). RCA at `deb85b35`, analyst + skeptic: both CONFIRMED / UPHELD.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked in this worktree):** (a) scroll — REQ-305 anchored the presenter's arrow to the node under his cursor and looked it up again only while a snapshot settled (`DemoStage.replace()` called `restAgain()` only while `restRef` was open); on every other scroll the customer's overlay carried the arrow with its element, to the window's edge drawn faint, while the stage still showed his cursor over another element — two screens, two models. (b) tab switch — `transport.follow()` told the tab it left nothing (a local `leave` only), so that tab kept the last anchor and showed it again on return; a presenter's relay went to every tab (the hub's `to: "all"`) while a direct move went to the followed tab only. (c) start / restart — the presenter's position came only from `onPointerMove` on the frame-sized layer, which exists only once the frame is mirrored; a mouse that has not moved fires nothing, and Chromium sends no pointer event at all to a page loaded under a still mouse, nor when an element appears under it (measured, headless shell and Chrome for Testing), so no pointer went out until he moved. (d) M8 — that layer was the frame's box: leaving it for the dark margins round a phone sent `leave`, the customer's arrow vanished, and the stage said nothing.
**Requirement:** one model on both screens — the presenter's resting pointer is the spot under his still mouse.
- The stage follows the presenter's mouse document-wide (the frame, the margins, the pill); only leaving the window sends `leave`. After every layout pass of the replay (a scroll, a change, its styles in, a settle, the stage resized) the resting pointer is looked up again and sent when it names another place — rated like a move, on the reliable channel — not only while a snapshot settles. This supersedes REQ-305's settle window and its "follows its element when the customer scrolls".
- Beside the frame the anchor is the point clamped to the frame's edge, marked off their screen (`o: 1`, never a node). The customer's overlay (and a colleague's stage) draws it on that edge, the whole arrow inside, marked outside (`placeIn(…, off)`); the stage outlines the frame and says "Your pointer is off {name}'s screen" (`demoMode.pointerOff`, en + es).
- A stage opened under a still mouse starts where the page that opened it last saw the mouse: the overlay hands the staff's last pointer position over (`handCursor`, this tab's sessionStorage) before it sends them to the stage, the stage hands its own over on `pagehide` (a reload, End), and the stage takes it once (`takeCursor`, at most 30 s old) and sends it with the first snapshot.
- Following another of the customer's tabs, the stage sends `leave` to the tab it left (a relay addressed to that one socket: `tab: <cid>`), every presenter relay to the customer goes to the followed tab only, and the newly followed tab gets the resting pointer at once.
**Tests:**
- unit `jest/unit/demo-stage-presenter-pointer.test.ts` ("REQ-393 …"): the off-screen anchor and the `tab` relay parse (junk dropped) and `sameAnchor` tells them apart; `outsideBox` and `placeIn(…, off)`; the cursor hand-off (taken once, fresh only, junk and a throwing store survive); the transport on a fake socket — the tab the stage leaves gets `{k:"leave"}` addressed to it, a tab that closed gets nothing, every presenter relay names the followed tab, a stage with no tab yet relays unaddressed; the stage's wiring (`replace()` pushes the rest throttle whenever the mouse is known, no settle window left, `restAgain` on the reliable channel, the off-screen anchor and resend, document-wide tracking with `leave` on the window only, the hand-off, the hint and the outline) and the overlay's (`placeIn(…, a.o === 1)`, the hand-off before `location.assign`); both dictionaries.
- unit `jest/unit/demo-mode-pointer-anchor.test.ts` — REQ-305's stage and overlay wiring cases amended to this model (no settle window; `placeIn` takes the off flag).
- unit `backend/src/demo-mode/domain/coordinators/demo-hub/test.ts` ("REQ-393 …"): a presenter's relay addressed to one tab reaches that tab only — never the customer's other tab nor a colleague — in one hub and across two.

## REQ-379 — The customer's demo pill has one home, in a band the page leaves for it: the same spot on every page and load, never over the page, never wider than the screen, and only its buttons take a click (demo-loop cycle 2, issues M1 + M6 + M28)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4, `demo-loop/runs/r561db6d4/demo-report.md`), issues `M1` "Customer's demo pill moves page to page, covers content/controls, intercepts clicks" (RCA CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD; all 8 pairs — "Expected: a fixed spot that does not cover what I am working on", pair 2), `M6` "Pill inline min-width wider than phone; End demo cut off; desktop truncation after ES switch" (CONFIRMED, UPHELD; pair 3: "`left:12px; min-width:400px` … End runs to x=400 on a 390 screen"; pair 8: a 760 px bar) and `M28` "Sidebar Dashboard link does nothing after clicking Message (sms:), even after a reload" (LIKELY; pair 6: "the browser said the pill 'intercepts pointer events'"). RCA at `deb85b35`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on demo-fixes deb85b35):** REQ-295 (`31acdd7b`) hunted for a slot with nothing of the page under it every 0.7 s (`planPill`/`pillSlots` in `shared/demo-mode/pill.ts`, `place()` in `front-end/islands/DemoModeOverlay.tsx`): on app pages no full-size corner was clear, so the pill went compact, then into "room" at the bottom-left — but `.app` (`dashboard.css`, `assistant-page.css`) is `calc(var(--app-vh) - var(--banner-h))` with `overflow:hidden` and never subtracted `--demo-pill-h`, so the shell's foot (Log out, the footer, the composer, Siguiente) stayed under the pill. Edge slots let it settle in transiently empty areas (mid-chat), a cramped → full flip after two clear checks moved it again, `crampedRef` reset on every load and the box was remembered per path, so it sat in a different place on every page and after a reload. RC-A (M6): `compact` started `false`, `place()` measured `offsetWidth` (366, capped by `max-width`), `reservedBox` rounded it to 400 and the render wrote `min-width:${pos.width}px` back — `min-width` beats `max-width`, every later measure read 400, and the box never shrank (`planPill` on the base: "check0: measured=366 -> width=400 … check3: measured=400 -> width=400"). While a dialog's backdrop was up `place()` returned early (REQ-300), so a dialog that opened under the pill stayed covered. The pill took every pointer event over its whole box (M28).
**Requirement:**
- ONE home: the customer's pill (and the Opening… / Back to the demo / ended pills) sits bottom-left — 12 px from the left, its bottom 8 px (`PILL_BAND_GAP`) above the visible bottom (`--vvh`/`--vvt`, so above an iOS keyboard) — in a band reserved under the page: `--demo-pill-h` on <html> is the pill's height rounded up to 8 px plus 8 px above and below, the body is padded by it (REQ-295's room, now always while a pill is up) and every viewport-high shell subtracts it like `--banner-h` (REQ-181): `.app` in `dashboard.css` and both in `assistant-page.css`, the phone's fixed assistant shell and chat, the phone's slide-in drawer (`.sb` ends above the band) and its conversations panel (`AsstThreads.tsx`), the phone dashboard's body-scroll shell and the onboarding wizard's shell (`min-height`), and Customers' flash toast. The page under the pill is the band, never a control or text of the app's shells; on a body-scroll phone page the content scrolls under the bar and the page's end clears it.
- No hunt: no slots, no per-path memory, no compact <-> full flip. The pill is compact (status + End, details on tap) exactly when the window is ≤ 640 px — from the first render (`useState(narrow)`) and at once when a resize crosses the line — and full otherwise. The same window and pill give the same home (`pillHome`) on every page and after every reload.
- Never wider than the screen: the pill is as wide as its content, capped at the window minus 12 px each side; nothing measured is ever written back into its style (no `min-width`). End, ×, Back to the demo and the status never shrink below their words (a live switch to Spanish keeps "Terminar demo" whole).
- A dialog never freezes it over its content: while a dialog's backdrop is up and the dialog's content is under the home, the pill docks at the top-left (under the impersonation banner) while that is clear, else stays home — two places, asked in that order (`dockPill`); a move glides 250 ms. While End's question is up nothing moves (REQ-300).
- Only its buttons take a click (M28): the pill's box is `pointer-events:none`; its buttons, End's question and both answers are `pointer-events:auto`.
- The phone pill's details, opened or closed, stay that way across a reload (the tab remembers that choice only — `pm-demo-pill:open` in sessionStorage through `pillStore`, REQ-153 AMENDMENT).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/demo-pill-home.test.ts` ("REQ-379 …", 19 cases: a 390 px phone with a pill measured 366 — or a stale 400 / 760 — is never wider than 366 and ends 12 px inside the screen; the home and the band's height (rounded to 8 px, a pixel of status does not move the page); `pillHome` takes the window and the pill only; `dockPill` — home clear → home, the dialog under it → top-left (under a banner), both covered → home, asked in that order; the open-details memory, junk and a throwing storage read closed; every `.app` height subtracts `var(--demo-pill-h, 0px)`, the phone's fixed assistant shell and chat, both drawers, the conversations panel, the phone dashboard's and the wizard's `min-height`, the Customers toast; the overlay uses `pillHome`/`dockPill`, has no `pillSlots|pickPillSlot|planPill|recallPillBox|rememberPillBox|crampedRef|UNCRAMP_CHECKS|ghostsOfPage`, writes no `min-width:${`, is anchored by `bottom:calc(100% - var(--vvt, 0px) - var(--vvh, 100%) + ${PILL_BAND_GAP}px)`, starts `useState(narrow)` and calls `setCompact(narrow())`, no longer returns early on a dialog, keeps REQ-300's End-question freeze, remembers the open details; the pill style is `pointer-events:none` and every `<button>` of the overlay plus End's `BTN`, its question and Keep going are `pointer-events:auto`); `jest/unit/demo-mode-pill.test.ts` (REQ-228/REQ-295 tests that still hold — the slot/corner/per-path tests removed with the code, see SUPERSEDED below); `jest/unit/impersonation-banner-room.test.ts` (REQ-181's shells may subtract the pill band after the banner's room) · integration n/a — the change is the browser's layout and the overlay's placement; ## REQ-398 — The public change-order page: the owner previews (no self-approval), the headline is the job total, and it has an EN | ES toggle (demo-loop cycle 2, M15 / m25 / p13-j)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4), issues `M15` "Contractor can approve their own change order on /co (no preview guard as on /q)", `m25` "Change order shows invoice totals, not job totals", `p13-j` "No EN/ES toggle on the change-order page". RCA at `deb85b35` (M15 CONFIRMED, m25 CONFIRMED, p13-j FEATURE_GAP; skeptic UPHELD all three).
**Cause (RCA):** REQ-306 guarded /q only — `getChangeOrderPublic` (public-controller/mod.ts) never read the session or returned `internal`, and `approveChangeOrder` / `declineChangeOrder` decided for any caller, so the owner's browser got the name field and "Approve this change". The page's totals came from the linked INVOICE (`originalAmountCents: invoice.amount`), so on a 50/50 job the +$850 order read "Current total $9,600 → New total $10,450" while the job went $19,200 → $20,050. `/co/[id].tsx` resolved its language without `?lang=` and mounted no toggle; the change-order alert linked a bare `/co/<id>`.
**Requirement:** (M15) `GET /change-orders/:id/public` says `internal: true` to the business's own viewer (owner, admin acting for them, staff behind an impersonation — `isInternalViewer`); `POST /change-orders/:id/approve` and `/decline` answer 409 `{reason:"owner_cannot_approve"}` to that viewer unless the full in-person override `?as=customer&confirm=1` is on (`hasSignOverride`); the anonymous customer is unaffected. `/co` forwards the viewer's session on its SSR read and, for a pending order, renders "Preview — you are viewing as the customer; approving is disabled / This is your own change order… / Customer here with you? Approve in person" (the link adds the override) instead of the form. (m25) The payload adds `jobCurrentAmount` / `jobNewAmount` — the quote's agreed total (REQ-205 ledger: quote total + other approved orders) before and after this order (`shared/quote-flow/change-order-view.ts changeOrderJobTotals`); the page's headline is "Job total $19,200.00 → $20,050.00" with "Added to INV-… ($9,600.00 → $10,450.00)" under it, and the invoice rows read "This invoice, now / before / after / proposed". With no linked quote the old labels stay. (p13-j) `/co` reads `?lang=` first (`resolvePublicLang`), sets `ctx.state.lang`, and mounts `PublicLangToggle` like /i (REQ-272); the change-order alert links `/co/<id>?lang=<commsLanguage>` (REQ-342 parity). The open page re-reads `GET /api/change-orders/:id/public` every 10 s (`front-end/lib/public-change-order-refresh.ts`, REQ-221 scheduler) and reloads when the status or version moves, and reloads after its own approve/decline, so the server-rendered headline and totals follow the decision (M13's /co part).
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/change-order-page.test.ts` ("REQ-398 …": `changeOrderJobTotals` for the demo's $19,200/+$850 job pending and approved, other approved/pending/declined orders, line-sum + credit floor; `changeOrderPreview` internal/override/half-override/customer/decided; `changeOrderMoved` + `startChangeOrderRefresh` polls the public URL and reloads once; wiring — ?lang= read first, PublicLangToggle, authed SSR read, banner + owner_cannot_approve + refresh in the island, job-total markup; en/es carry the ten new keys) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/change-order-owner.int.test.ts` ("REQ-398 M15 …": `internal` for owner header/cookie and staff impersonation, none for anonymous or another account; owner/staff approve + decline → 409 owner_cannot_approve and the order stays pending, a half override is refused, the full override approves, the anonymous customer approves and declines; "REQ-398 m25 …": job $1,920,000 → $2,005,000 next to invoice $960,000 → $1,045,000, unchanged after approval) and `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-change-order-alert/int.test.ts` ("REQ-398 p13-j …": es and en sends link `/co/<id>?lang=<lang>` in the customer's email and SMS) · e2e `e2e/change-order-page/change-order-page.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-398 M15/m25/p13-j …": the owner's browser sees the preview banner and no name field / approve button, the job total $19,200.00 → $20,050.00 and "Added to INV-… ($9,600.00 → $10,450.00)"; a cookie-less customer context opens `?lang=es` ("Aprobar este cambio", ES current), toggles to EN, approves, the headline reads Approved; the owner's open tab drops the banner on its own).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c2-change-order-page off demo-fixes deb85b35):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern change-order-page` → "Cannot find module '../../shared/quote-flow/change-order-view'" (1 suite failed); `deno test -A --unstable-kv` on the two int files → 5 FAILED (M15: `internal` `undefined` ≠ `true`; owner approve 200 ≠ 409; m25: "Values are not equal: the job, now"; p13-j: email body lacks `/co/<id>?lang=es` / `?lang=en`); `shots run e2e/change-order-page` with the four source files checked out from deb85b35 → "✗ REQ-398 … locator.waitFor: Timeout 15000ms exceeded" (no preview banner for the owner). GREEN — the two int files "5 passed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/` → "ok | 283 passed | 0 failed"; chat change-order e2e + apply-chat-change-order "2 passed"; `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 209 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2014 passed"; `shots run e2e/change-order-page` → "✓ REQ-398 … 14.4s · 1 pass · 0 fail"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on the route, island, refresh lib, shared module and the backend controller/tests; `deno fmt` clean on every touched/created ts/tsx file except `send-change-order-alert/mod.ts`, which was already unformatted at deb85b35 (left as is). ## REQ-390 — The chat's customer form names every problem in place and only turns red once touched; duplicates say which customer they mean; same-name cards are told apart; a custom duration and the onboarding steps never block or rewrite silently (demo-loop cycle 2, issues m18, m19, M18)
**Source:** Raphael: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4, demo-report.md), issues `m18` ("Validation gaps: in-chat form one error at a time, onboarding blocks silently, -3 duration becomes 1, no language checked"), `m19` ("Red 'Add a phone number or email' error shown before anything typed") and `M18` ("Duplicate customers easy to create; two 'Bob' cards cannot be told apart"); RCA analyst CONFIRMED + skeptic UPHELD for all three at demo-fixes `deb85b35`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on deb85b35):** (1) `front-end/islands/AsstChat.tsx` CustomerStepPanel's form called `customerContactError`, which returns only the first bad field (phone before email); REQ-352's per-field `customerFormErrors` was wired only into ClientsPage. (2) REQ-029's missing-contact reason rendered from first paint in the red `.cust-pick__err`, with no touched state. (3) `findExistingCustomer` falls back to a name-only match, and the warning named only `dupe.name` — "Looks like Bob already exists" for a Bob with another phone; `ClientsBoard.tsx`'s card face had no phone or C-number, so two Bobs looked identical. (4) CustomDurationPickerForm clamped on input (`Math.max(1, Math.min(99, Number(raw) || 1))`) and validated the clamped number, so "-3" became "1 day" (from 5441fd71). (5) `WelcomeWizard.tsx`: a whitespace-only name / business name disabled Continue with no message; the ZIP (and payment handle) reason waited for blur; the last ticked send-in language returned early from `toggleSendIn` with no state change while the controlled box unticked in the DOM.
**Requirement:** (a) The assistant's "Who is this for?" form gives one message per field, all at once (`customerStepFeedback` in `shared/quote-flow/customer-contact.ts`, built on `customerFormErrors`): a bad phone under the phone, a bad email under the email (`data-cy` `cust-phone-err` / `cust-email-err`, `aria-describedby`), the contractor's own phone/email on that field, the empty name once the name field was left. (b) REQ-029 stays — the missing-contact reason is visible from the start — but as a neutral `.cust-pick__hint` until a contact field was typed in or left; then it is the red `.cust-pick__err`. (c) The duplicate warning shows the existing customer's contact — "Bob · (512) 555-0142 already exists — use them?" — and when only the name matched while the typed phone/email reaches someone else it reads "You already have another Bob · (512) 555-0142. Same person?" (`duplicateNotice` in `shared/quote-flow/customer-dedupe.ts`); a match with no contact keeps the old wording. (d) On /customers, every visible card whose folded name another visible card shares carries a tag on its face (`data-cy="ccard2-disambig"`): the C-number, else the phone's last four, else the email (`cardDisambiguators` in `front-end/lib/clients-display.ts`). (e) The custom duration keeps what was typed and checks it as typed: a whole number 1–99 or "Enter a whole number from 1 to 99." (`parseDurationNumber`, `shared/quote-flow/duration-input.ts`); Lock it in stays off and the preview never reads a number that was not typed. (f) Onboarding: a name or business name of only spaces says "Type a name — spaces alone don't count."; a ZIP or pay handle still being typed shows its reason as a neutral `.welcome__hint` (red after blur, as REQ-352); the last ticked send-in language is disabled with "At least one language stays on…". en and es carry every new string.

## REQ-395 — A draft quote revision only exists while it differs from the published version, can be discarded, says by name what it changes, and its editor is labelled (demo-loop cycle 2, issues M12, m24, m27, p13-i)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo's findings: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4), issues `M12` ("Unwanted draft revision can't be discarded; publish box says 'Wording or terms updated — total/items unchanged'"), `m24` ("Revision doesn't name the changed line or update scope; editor merged two lines"), `m27` ("Stale 'Saved as unpublished Version 2' line stays above 'Revision published'"), `p13-i` ("Revision editor fields have no labels"). RCA analyst + skeptic CONFIRMED/UPHELD (m24 FEATURE_GAP) at demo-fixes `deb85b35`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on deb85b35):** (M12) `QuoteStore.setPending` (`backend/src/paperwork/domain/data/quote-store/mod.ts`) spread every patch into `pendingRevision` and never compared it with the live record, so a V3 edited back to equal V2 stayed "Unpublished changes"; QuoteStore had no `clearPending` and no route discarded a revision; the publish preview fell back to `quotes.ledger.publishOtherChanges` whenever the line summary was empty (`QuotesPage.tsx`), even when nothing differed. (m24) `versionChanges` / `versionChangeLine` (`shared/documents/versions.ts`, `linked-view.ts`) only counted lines ("1 line added"). The "merged two lines" part is not a bug: the quote had one line item, the two bullets were the JOB DETAILS narrative; regenerating scope on revision is a separate feature, out of scope. (m27) `OpenQuotePanel`'s `savedVersion` was only reset on a new quote or Edit; the ledger's `onPublished={onRefresh}` left it. (p13-i) `QuoteLineEditor`'s inputs had no label/aria-label; the header row was plain spans.
**Requirement:** (1) Saving a pending revision keeps only what still differs from the live quote (`effectivePendingRevision`: lines compared on description / qty / unit / price by position, other fields structurally); when nothing differs the quote carries no `pendingRevision` — no badge, publish answers `nothing_to_publish`. This holds for every `setPending` caller (the editor's PUT, revise_quote, the chat change order). (2) `POST /quotes/:id/discard-revision` (owner only; 409 `locked_signed` on a signed quote; harmless when nothing is pending) drops the pending revision via `QuoteStore.clearPending`; the panel shows a quiet "Discard draft" / "Descartar borrador" by the UNPUBLISHED CHANGES badge. (3) `VersionChanges` carries the lines by name (`added` / `removed` / `changed`, each `{description, totalCents}`), and `versionChangeLine` reads "Total $18,500.00 → $19,200.00 · Added: Tile backsplash ($700.00)" (es "Agregado: …"; "Removed:" / "Changed: X ($a → $b)"), falling back to counts for a change without names — on the publish preview, the version history and the customer's page alike. (4) The preview says "Wording or terms updated" only when a non-line content field really differs (`pendingOtherContentChanged`), else "Nothing to publish" with Publish disabled. (5) Publishing or discarding clears "Saved as unpublished Version N", and that line shows only while a revision is pending. (6) Each editor input has `aria-label` "Description N" / "Qty N" / "Price ($) N" and a placeholder ("Line description", "Qty", "$").
**Tests:** unit `jest/unit/quote-revision-discard.test.ts` ("REQ-395 …": `effectivePendingRevision`, `pendingOtherContentChanged`, named `versionChanges` + `versionChangeLine` en/es, the panel's Discard button / client route / preview copy / savedVersion reset / input labels, en+es keys); `jest/unit/quote-revision-notice.test.ts` REQ-248 expectations amended to the named form · integration `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/revisions-controller/discard-revision.int.test.ts` ("REQ-395 (demo M12) …": a sent quote edited to add a line then back → no `pendingRevision`, publish 409; `POST /quotes/:id/discard-revision` drops it, live + version untouched, idempotent, foreign owner refused, signed quote 409 `locked_signed`) · e2e `e2e/quote-revision-discard/quote-revision-discard.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-395: …" in a browser: inputs found by role + name "Description 1"/"Qty 1"/"Description 2"/"Price ($) 2", the preview reads "… · Added: Tile backsplash ($700.00)", Discard draft clears the badge and the API's pendingRevision, an edit saved back to V2 leaves no badge or saved line, publish removes the saved line).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c2-quote-revision-discard off demo-fixes deb85b35):** RED first — `npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/quote-revision-discard.test.ts` → "Tests: 13 failed" (`effectivePendingRevision is not a function`, `pendingOtherContentChanged is not a function`, Received "Total $18,500.00 → $19,200.00 · 1 line added", `onPublished={onRefresh}`, no `quote-discard-draft`, no aria-label, lang keys undefined); `deno test -A --unstable-kv …/discard-revision.int.test.ts` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed" (pendingRevision `{lineItems:[Shingles]…}` instead of undefined; discard route 404); `shots run e2e/quote-revision-discard` with the implementation reverted → "✗ … locator.waitFor: Timeout 10000ms exceeded" (no input named "Description 1"). GREEN — the int file "ok | 2 passed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/ src/agents/domain/coordinators/revise-quote/ src/agents/domain/coordinators/apply-chat-change-order/` → "ok | 280 passed | 0 failed"; `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 209 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2015 passed"; `SHOTS_JOBS=1 shots run e2e/quote-revision-discard` → "✓ REQ-395 … 1 pass · 0 fail"; `deno check` + `deno lint` clean on QuotesPage.tsx, clients/quotes.ts, components/quote-doc.tsx, shared/documents/{versions,linked-view}.ts, the store, the controller and the new tests; `deno fmt --check` clean on every touched file.
## REQ-377 — A new total typed in the assistant ("change Q-001 to $19,750") is subtracted by the server, and a model's change-order amount is checked against the dollars typed (demo-loop cycle 2, issue B1)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12, on the 20-agent demo's findings: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4, demo-report.md), issue `B1` — "Assistant adds revision line at a tenth of the price ($125 instead of $1,250)" (pair 5: "Dana wants a tile backsplash too — change Q-001 to $19,750" on the sent $18,500 Q-001 → "Added Tile backsplash ($125.00) to Q-001 Kitchen Remodel as a revision"; editor "Tile backsplash 1 × 125 → New total $18,625.00"). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic CORRECTED (cause narrowed) at `deb85b35`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked on demo-fixes deb85b35):** the sentence is a target-TOTAL change order, and no deterministic path read it — `parseChangeOrderRequest` needs the words "change order" and `parseLineReprice` skips `Q-\d+` — so the LLM got the turn, rightly called `change_order` (the add-a-line tool), and had to compute `deltaAmountCents` = target − current total in cents itself: it wrote 12500 for 125000. `ApplyChatChangeOrder.run` (`backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/apply-chat-change-order/mod.ts`) appended `{price: delta}` to the pending revision unchanged, with no check against the $19,750 typed or the quote's total. (Allowing `revise_quote` in the terms phase is a separate defect, M11 — revise_quote cannot add a line.)
**Requirement:** (1) "change/make/set/bring Q-00N | the total | the quote … (up) to $X", "new total $X", "total should be $X", "cambia Q-001 a $X", "nuevo total $X" with ONE dollar amount is read in code (`parseTargetTotalChange`, `change-order-intent/mod.ts`) together with the work it adds ("Dana wants a tile backsplash too" → "Tile backsplash"); on a named quote or the conversation's issued one it runs before any model as a change order carrying `targetTotalCents`. (2) The coordinator computes delta = new total − the job's current total (the pending revision's lines when one is waiting, else the quote's), so the new total lands exactly; a new total with no work named asks what the difference is for (`needs_description`, nothing written); the total already being that → `no_change`. (3) A model-supplied `deltaAmountCents` is cross-checked against the dollars the contractor typed (`reconcileChangeOrderDelta`): it stands when it is ±$A, or $A minus the current total / a line's price (REQ-315's signed-quote reprice difference); off by ×10/×100 from exactly one of those it is corrected (the demo's 12500 → 125000); anything else is asked about (`needs_amount`, nothing written); no amount typed → it stands. (4) The `change_order` tool takes the new total in DOLLARS (`newTotalDollars`), converted to cents and subtracted in code; only `description` is required.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/agents/domain/business/change-order-intent/test.ts` ("REQ-377 B1 parseTargetTotalChange: …" the pair-5 sentence → Q-001, 1975000, "Tile backsplash"; no-item, other EN/ES phrasings; a line reprice, an added amount, two amounts → undefined · "REQ-377 B1 reconcileChangeOrderDelta: …" 12500 on $19,750 / $18,500 → 125000; typed amount, credit, line difference and right target delta stand; no amount stands; 99900 → ask), `backend/src/agents/domain/business/openai-tools/test.ts` ("REQ-377 B1 TOOL_DEFS / parseToolCall: …" newTotalDollars 19750 → targetTotalCents 1975000) · integration `backend/src/agents/domain/coordinators/handle-chat-message/int.test.ts` ("REQ-377 B1: …" the exact sentence on the bound sent $18,500 quote with the model scripted to 12500 → pending line Tile backsplash 125000, total 1975000, reply "$1,250.00"; a second new total is measured from the pending revision; no item → asks, nothing written; the model's 12500 on an unparsed phrasing is corrected; 99900 → needs_amount, nothing written; the tool's targetTotalCents is subtracted in code) · e2e `backend/src/agents/entrypoints/chat-controller/change-order.e2e.test.ts` ("REQ-377 B1 e2e: …" booted app over HTTP: Q-001 $18,500 sent, the demo sentence in a new conversation → pendingRevision total 1975000, last line Tile backsplash 125000, reply "$1,250.00"; the browser lane is not run in the demo-loop fix step — the chat UI renders the reply text and quote verbatim).
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c2-change-order-target off demo-fixes deb85b35):** RED first — unit change-order-intent: "TS2305 … has no exported member 'parseTargetTotalChange' / 'reconcileChangeOrderDelta'"; openai-tools `--filter REQ-377` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 2 failed"; int `--filter REQ-377` → "FAILED | 0 passed | 6 failed", the demo test's diff `["Tile backsplash", - 12500 + 125000]` (the demo's exact $125 line reproduced); e2e `--filter REQ-377` → "pendingRevision.estimatedTotal - undefined + 1975000". GREEN — `deno test -A --unstable-kv` change-order-intent "ok | 23 passed", openai-tools "ok | 30 passed", handle-chat-message int "ok | 65 passed", chat-controller change-order e2e "ok | 3 passed"; `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/agents/` → "499 passed | 1 failed" — the one is `openai/smk.test.ts` "REQ-368 … no allowlist keeps every tool" (expects no `revise_quote`), which fails identically on untouched demo-fixes deb85b35 ("12 passed | 1 failed", M11's domain); `deno lint` clean on the 9 touched .ts files; `npx jest --selectProjects unit --testPathPattern "i18n|lang|copy"` → 22 suites / 242 passed; en/es key sets equal (3882 each). Formatted only files that were fmt-clean at the base (openai-tools/mod.ts + test.ts and int.test.ts were not; left as they were).
## REQ-403 — After a failed text the app never says it was texted, nor promises a text confirmation (demo-loop cycle 2, issue m11)
**Source:** Raphael, 2026-11-12: "fix every issue the demo found, loop until there are none." Demo-loop cycle 2 (run r561db6d4, demo-report.md), issue `m11` — "After a failed text the app says it was sent/delivered and promises SMS confirmation" (fleet-4 stdout:296 "Texted to +15125550177" after the send said text FAILED; fleet-1 stdout:373 "Firmado y vinculante — Te enviaremos la confirmación por mensaje de texto" to a 555 number that failed; fleet-1 stdout:374 the red "Ese número no recibe mensajes" box still shown after "Cotización aceptada"). RCA analyst CONFIRMED, skeptic UPHELD at `deb85b35`.
**Cause (RCA, re-checked):** (a) `send-signed-confirmation/mod.ts` sent the completion SMS with `this.sms.send` directly and logged a "text" comms-trail row on `res.ok`, skipping the `isFictionalUsNumber` guard `send-paperwork-sms` applies; the dev SMS fake answers ok for +1 512 555-0177 (fictional: exchange 555, line 01xx), so the receipts strip read "Texted to". (b) `front-end/components/quote-doc.tsx` picked `signedNoteSms` whenever the customer had no email, without checking that a phone exists or that the last text failed. (c) `AsstChat.tsx`'s recovery form (`needRecovery`, fed by `lastRecoveryDividerId`) never looked at `quoteAccepted`.
**Requirement:** every customer text goes through ONE guarded dispatch — `dispatchCustomerSms` in `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/customer-sms/mod.ts` (missing / invalid / fictional never reach the provider) — used by the quote/invoice send and the post-signing completion text alike, and a comms-trail "text" row is logged only for a real delivery. `GET /quotes/:id/public` carries `confirmChannel` (`signedConfirmChannel`): "email" when the customer has one, "text" only for a textable number whose latest text did not fail, else "none". The signed page's line follows it (`shared/quote-flow/signed-note.ts` `signedNoteKey`): the email note, the text note, or the neutral "Your contractor has your signed copy. Keep one for yourself with Download PDF below." (en + es). The chat's contact-recovery form is gone once the quote is accepted.
**Tests:** unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/business/customer-sms/mod.test.ts` ("REQ-403 …": target codes, a fictional number never dialled even in dev mode, `signedConfirmChannel` table) · unit `backend/src/paperwork/domain/coordinators/send-signed-confirmation/sms-guard.test.ts` ("REQ-403 (m11) …": no dial + no "text" row for +15125550177; a real number texted and logged once; a provider rejection logs nothing) · unit `jest/unit/failed-sms-truth.test.ts` ("REQ-403 (m11) …": `signedNoteKey`, the en/es neutral copy, quote-doc uses it; `lastRecoveryDividerId(…, { accepted: true })` is undefined and AsstChat passes `quoteAccepted`) · integration `backend/src/paperwork/entrypoints/public-controller/failed-sms-truth.int.test.ts` ("REQ-403 (m11) …", app booted over HTTP, SMS in dev mode: signing a quote to +15125550177 leaves no "text" row in `GET /messages` and `confirmChannel` "none"; a real number whose latest text failed → "none"; a texted real number → "text" and one logged completion text; an email → "email") · e2e n/a — the page renders `confirmChannel` through the pure `signedNoteKey` (unit-pinned) and the int test asserts the exact JSON the /q page and the receipts strip read; the recovery form's gate is a pure scan, unit-pinned with the island's call site.
**Evidence (2026-11-12, branch fix/c2-failed-sms-truth off demo-fixes deb85b35):** RED first — `deno test -A --unstable-kv …/send-signed-confirmation/sms-guard.test.ts` → "FAILED | 2 passed | 1 failed" ("the fictional number was dialled", `-1 +0`); `deno test -A --unstable-kv …/public-controller/failed-sms-truth.int.test.ts` → "a 'text' receipt was logged for a number that cannot get texts" (`- ["+15125550177"] + []`, the demo's exact line); `customer-sms/mod.test.ts` → "Cannot find module …/customer-sms/mod.ts"; `npx jest --selectProjects unit unit/failed-sms-truth` → "Could not locate module ../../shared/quote-flow/signed-note.ts". GREEN — `deno test -A --unstable-kv src/paperwork/ src/agents/domain/coordinators/send-quote/ src/agents/domain/coordinators/list-conversations/` → "ok | 312 passed | 0 failed"; `npx jest --selectProjects unit` → "Test Suites: 209 passed · Tests: 1 skipped, 2009 passed"; `deno lint` + `deno check` clean on quote-doc.tsx, send-delivery.ts, AsstChat.tsx and the touched backend modules; `deno fmt --check` clean on every new file and on quote-doc.tsx / send-delivery.ts (AsstChat.tsx not formatted — known-unformattable).
